Regularly review and update the password management process to address emerging security threats and best practices.
Train users on the password management policy and the procedures for resetting forgotten passwords.

controls.name: review of user access rights
controls.description: Management shall review usersΓÇÖ access rights at regular intervals using a formal process.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular reviews of user access rights, such as quarterly or bi-annually.
Create a formal process for conducting access rights reviews, including criteria for evaluation and documentation of findings.
Involve relevant stakeholders in the review process to ensure comprehensive evaluation of access rights.
Document any changes made to user access rights as a result of the review and communicate these changes to affected users.
Train management and staff on the importance of regular access rights reviews and the procedures to follow.

controls.name: password use
controls.description: Users shall be required to follow good security practices in the selection and use of passwords.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate guidelines on best practices for password selection, including length, complexity, and uniqueness.
Implement a password policy that enforces the use of strong passwords and regular password changes.
Educate users on the risks associated with weak passwords and the importance of safeguarding their passwords.
Monitor compliance with the password policy and provide feedback to users who do not adhere to the guidelines.
Offer training sessions on password security and the use of password managers to enhance password management.

controls.name: unattended user equipment
controls.description: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

deployment_points.name: Establish a policy requiring users to lock or log off their devices when leaving them unattended.
Implement automatic screen lock features on all devices to minimize unauthorized access when unattended.
Educate users on the importance of securing unattended equipment and the potential risks of leaving devices open.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the unattended equipment policy and address any violations.
Provide training on how to properly secure equipment and the procedures for reporting any security incidents.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen policy
controls.description: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear desk and clear screen policy that outlines expectations for maintaining a secure workspace.
Communicate the policy to all employees and provide training on its importance for information security.
Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with the clear desk and clear screen policy.
Provide secure storage options for sensitive documents and removable media to facilitate adherence to the policy.
Establish consequences for non-compliance to reinforce the importance of maintaining a secure work environment.
Develop a comprehensive network usage policy that outlines acceptable use, security measures, and consequences for violations.
Ensure the policy is communicated to all users and stakeholders through training sessions and documentation.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in technology and organizational needs.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the policy and identify any unauthorized usage.
Establish a process for reporting and addressing violations of the network usage policy.

controls.name: user authentication for external connections
controls.description: Appropriate authentication methods shall be used to control access by remote users.

deployment_points.name: Identify and implement strong authentication methods such as multi-factor authentication (MFA) for remote access.
Ensure that all remote users are required to authenticate using their unique credentials before accessing the network.
Regularly review and update authentication methods to align with best practices and emerging threats.
Provide training for users on secure authentication practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.
Monitor and log authentication attempts to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: equipment identification in networks
controls.description: Automatic equipment identification shall be considered as a means to authenticate connections from specific locations and equipment.

deployment_points.name: Implement automatic equipment identification systems that can recognize and authenticate devices connecting to the network.
Maintain an inventory of authorized devices and their corresponding identification parameters.
Configure network access controls to allow only recognized devices to connect, blocking unauthorized devices.
Regularly audit the list of authorized devices to ensure it is up-to-date and reflects current organizational needs.
Train IT staff on the importance of equipment identification and the procedures for managing device access.

controls.name: remote diagnostic and configuration port protection
controls.description: Physical and logical access to diagnostic and configuration ports shall be controlled.

deployment_points.name: Restrict physical access to diagnostic and configuration ports to authorized personnel only.
Implement logical access controls, such as password protection and encryption, for remote access to these ports.
Regularly review access logs to monitor who accesses the diagnostic and configuration ports and when.
Establish a procedure for granting and revoking access to these ports based on role and necessity.
Conduct periodic security assessments to identify vulnerabilities related to port access and implement necessary improvements.

controls.name: segregation in networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users, and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

deployment_points.name: Design the network architecture to create separate segments for different user groups and information services.
Implement access controls to restrict communication between network segments based on user roles and data sensitivity.
Regularly review and update network segmentation to adapt to changes in organizational structure and security requirements.
Monitor traffic between segments to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts.
Provide training to network administrators on the importance of network segregation and best practices for maintaining it.

controls.name: network connection control
controls.description: For shared networks, especially those extending across the organizationΓÇÖs boundaries, the capability of users to connect to the network shall be restricted, in line with the access control policy and requirements of the business applications.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the access control policy that specifies who can connect to the network and under what conditions.
Implement technical controls, such as firewalls and access control lists, to enforce the connection restrictions outlined in the policy.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure compliance with the access control policy and adjust as necessary.
Provide training to users on the importance of adhering to connection policies and the risks of unauthorized access.
Monitor network connections to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts promptly.

controls.name: network routing control
controls.description: Routing controls shall be implemented for networks to ensure that computer connections and information flows do not breach the access control policy of the business applications.

deployment_points.name: Configure routing protocols and devices to enforce the access control policy and prevent unauthorized data flows.
Regularly review and update routing configurations to ensure they align with current security policies and business needs.
Implement monitoring tools to track data flows and detect any anomalies that may indicate policy breaches.
Train network administrators on routing controls and the importance of maintaining compliance with access control policies.
Conduct periodic audits of routing configurations and access controls to identify and remediate any vulnerabilities.

controls.name: secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Access to operating systems shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

deployment_points.name: Implement secure log-on procedures that require strong authentication methods, such as passwords or biometrics.
Ensure that all log-on attempts are logged and monitored for suspicious activity.
Regularly review and update log-on procedures to incorporate best practices and address emerging threats.
Provide user training on secure log-on practices and the importance of protecting their credentials.
Establish a process for responding to failed log-on attempts, including account lockout policies and incident response procedures.

controls.name: user identification and authentication
controls.description: All users shall have a unique identifier (user ID) for their personal use only, and a suitable authentication technique shall be chosen to substantiate the claimed identity of a user.

deployment_points.name: Assign unique user IDs to all users to ensure accountability and traceability of actions within the system.
Implement strong authentication techniques, such as multi-factor authentication, to verify user identities.
Regularly review user accounts to ensure they are active and that access rights are appropriate.
Provide training to users on the importance of maintaining the confidentiality of their user IDs and authentication methods.
Monitor authentication logs to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: password management system
controls.description: Systems for managing passwords shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

deployment_points.name: Implement an interactive password management system that enforces strong password policies, including complexity and length requirements.
Provide users with guidance on creating secure passwords and the importance of password uniqueness.
Regularly review and update password policies to align with best practices and address emerging threats.
Monitor password change requests and ensure that users are not reusing old passwords.
Provide training to users on the importance of password security and the risks associated with weak passwords.

controls.name: use of system utilities
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all system utilities that are available on the operating system and categorize them based on their potential impact on system controls.
Develop a policy that defines which utilities are permitted for use and under what circumstances, ensuring that only authorized personnel can access them.
Implement access controls to restrict the execution of unauthorized utilities, using role-based access control (RBAC) or similar mechanisms.
Regularly review and audit the use of system utilities to ensure compliance with the established policy and to identify any unauthorized access attempts.
Provide training for users and administrators on the risks associated with system utilities and the importance of adhering to the established controls.

controls.name: session time-out
controls.description: Inactive sessions shall shut down after a defined period of inactivity.

deployment_points.name: Define a specific period of inactivity after which user sessions will automatically time out, based on the sensitivity of the information accessed.
Configure the operating system and applications to enforce session time-out settings, ensuring that they are applied consistently across all user accounts.
Communicate the session time-out policy to all users, explaining the rationale and the importance of security in protecting sensitive information.
Monitor and log session time-out events to identify patterns of inactivity and potential security risks associated with unattended sessions.
Regularly review and adjust the time-out settings as necessary to balance user convenience with security requirements.

controls.name: limitation of connection time
controls.description: Restrictions on connection times shall be used to provide additional security for high-risk applications.

deployment_points.name: Identify high-risk applications and determine appropriate connection time restrictions based on their security requirements.
Implement technical controls to enforce connection time limitations, such as configuring firewalls or access control lists (ACLs) to restrict access during specified hours.
Develop a policy that outlines the connection time restrictions, including exceptions and the process for requesting access outside of normal hours.
Train users on the connection time limitations and the importance of adhering to these restrictions to mitigate security risks.
Regularly review and assess the effectiveness of connection time restrictions, making adjustments as necessary based on user feedback and security assessments.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions by users and support personnel shall be restricted in accordance with the defined access control policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that defines user roles, responsibilities, and the level of access required for different information and application functions.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure that users are granted access only to the information and functions necessary for their job responsibilities.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure they align with the access control policy and make adjustments as necessary when roles change.
Conduct training sessions for users and support personnel on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to access restrictions.
Monitor and log access attempts to sensitive information and application functions to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: sensitive system isolation
controls.description: Sensitive systems shall have a dedicated (isolated) computing environment.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive systems that require isolation based on the data they handle and their criticality to the organization.
Design and implement a dedicated computing environment for sensitive systems, ensuring that it is physically and logically separated from other systems.
Establish strict access controls to the isolated environment, allowing only authorized personnel to access sensitive systems.
Regularly assess the security of the isolated environment, including vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, to identify and mitigate potential risks.
Document and maintain policies and procedures for managing the isolated environment, including incident response plans specific to sensitive systems.

controls.name: mobile computing and communications
controls.description: A formal policy shall be in place, and appropriate security measures shall be adopted to protect against the risks of using mobile computing and communication facilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal mobile computing and communications policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and responsibilities for users of mobile devices.
Implement security measures such as encryption, remote wipe capabilities, and strong authentication methods for all mobile devices accessing organizational data.
Provide training for employees on the mobile computing policy, including best practices for securing devices and data while on the go.
Regularly review and update the mobile computing policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor the use of mobile devices and communications to ensure compliance with the policy and to identify any potential security incidents.

controls.name: teleworking
controls.description: A policy, operational plans and procedures shall be developed and implemented for teleworking activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive teleworking policy that outlines the expectations, responsibilities, and security requirements for employees working remotely.
Create operational plans that detail the technical and physical security measures required for teleworking, including secure access to company resources.
Provide training for teleworkers on the teleworking policy and best practices for maintaining security while working from home or other remote locations.
Implement monitoring and reporting mechanisms to ensure compliance with the teleworking policy and to identify any security incidents.
Regularly review and update the teleworking policy and operational plans to adapt to changes in the work environment and emerging security threats.

controls.name: security requirements
controls.description: Statements of business requirements for new information systems, analysis and specification or enhancements to existing information systems shall specify the requirements for security controls.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for documenting security requirements as part of the business requirements for new information systems and enhancements to existing systems.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and define security controls that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
Ensure that security requirements are reviewed and approved by relevant stakeholders before finalizing business requirements.
Integrate security requirements into the system development lifecycle (SDLC) to ensure they are considered at every stage of system design and implementation.
Regularly review and update security requirements to reflect changes in technology, threats, and business needs.

controls.name: input data validation
controls.description: Data input to applications shall be validated to ensure that this data is correct and appropriate.

deployment_points.name: Define validation rules for all data inputs based on business requirements and data integrity standards.
Implement input validation checks within applications to ensure that only correctly formatted and appropriate data is accepted.
Conduct testing of input validation mechanisms to ensure they function correctly and effectively prevent invalid data from being processed.
Provide training for developers and users on the importance of data validation and the potential risks associated with invalid data inputs.
Regularly review and update validation rules and mechanisms to adapt to changes in business requirements and emerging threats.

controls.name: control of internal processing
controls.description: Validation checks shall be incorporated into applications to detect any corruption of information through processing errors or deliberate acts.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical processing functions within applications that require validation checks to ensure data integrity and accuracy.
Implement validation checks at key points in the processing workflow to detect and prevent corruption of information.
Conduct regular testing and audits of validation checks to ensure they are effective in identifying processing errors or deliberate acts of data corruption.
Provide training for developers on best practices for incorporating validation checks into application design and development.
Establish a process for reviewing and updating validation checks to address new threats and changes in processing requirements.

controls.name: message integrity
controls.description: Requirements for ensuring authenticity and protecting message integrity in applications shall be identified, and appropriate controls identified and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of messages that require integrity checks within the application.
Implement cryptographic hash functions to generate message digests for integrity verification.
Establish a process for validating message integrity at both the sender and receiver ends.
Document and communicate the procedures for handling integrity failures to relevant stakeholders.
Regularly review and update the integrity controls to adapt to new threats and vulnerabilities.

controls.name: output data validation
controls.description: Data output from an application shall be validated to ensure that the processing of stored information is correct and appropriate to the circumstances.

deployment_points.name: Define validation criteria based on the expected output format and data types.
Implement automated validation checks within the application to verify output data against the defined criteria.
Create a logging mechanism to record validation results and any discrepancies found.
Establish a review process for handling validation failures, including escalation procedures.
Periodically test and update validation rules to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: policy on the use of cryptographic controls
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive policy outlining the use of cryptographic controls, including key management and encryption standards.
Ensure the policy is reviewed and approved by relevant stakeholders, including legal and compliance teams.
Train employees on the importance of cryptographic controls and the specifics of the policy.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the policy across all departments.
Regularly review and update the policy to reflect changes in technology and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: key management
controls.description: Key management shall be in place to support the organizationΓÇÖs use of cryptographic techniques.

deployment_points.name: Establish a key management policy that defines roles, responsibilities, and procedures for key generation, distribution, and storage.
Implement secure key storage solutions, such as hardware security modules (HSMs), to protect cryptographic keys.
Regularly rotate cryptographic keys to minimize the risk of compromise.
Create a process for revoking and replacing keys in case of a security breach or personnel changes.
Conduct periodic audits of the key management process to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

controls.name: control of operational software
controls.description: There shall be procedures in place to control the installation of software on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document procedures for the installation of software on operational systems, including approval workflows.
Implement access controls to restrict software installation to authorized personnel only.
Maintain an inventory of all software installed on operational systems for tracking and auditing purposes.
Regularly review and update installation procedures to address new security threats and vulnerabilities.
Conduct training sessions for staff on the importance of following installation procedures and the risks of non-compliance.

controls.name: protection of system test data
controls.description: Test data shall be selected carefully, and protected and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify test data based on sensitivity and compliance requirements.
Implement access controls to restrict who can view and use test data.
Use data masking techniques to anonymize sensitive information in test datasets.
Establish procedures for securely storing and disposing of test data after use.
Regularly review and audit the handling of test data to ensure compliance with security policies.

controls.name: access control to program source code
controls.description: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

deployment_points.name: Define access control policies that specify who can access program source code and under what conditions.
Implement role-based access controls (RBAC) to enforce these policies effectively.
Use version control systems to track changes to source code and maintain an audit trail.
Conduct regular reviews of access permissions to ensure they are up-to-date and appropriate.
Provide training for developers on secure coding practices and the importance of source code protection.

controls.name: change control procedures
controls.description: The implementation of changes shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop formal change control procedures that outline the steps for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes.
Implement a change management system to document all change requests and their statuses.
Establish a change advisory board (CAB) to review and approve significant changes.
Conduct impact assessments for changes to evaluate potential risks and effects on operations.
Train staff on the change control process and the importance of adhering to established procedures.

controls.name: technical review of applications after operating system changes
controls.description: When operating systems are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

deployment_points.name: Establish a protocol for reviewing business-critical applications following any operating system changes.
Create a checklist of key functionalities and security aspects to be tested during the review.
Assign responsibilities for conducting the reviews to qualified personnel.
Document the results of the reviews and any issues identified for future reference.
Schedule regular reviews of applications to ensure ongoing compatibility with the operating system.

controls.name: restrictions on changes to software packages
controls.description: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes, and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy that outlines the restrictions and procedures for modifying software packages.
Implement a formal approval process for any necessary changes to software packages.
Maintain documentation of all changes made, including the rationale and approval details.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the change restrictions policy.
Provide training to staff on the risks associated with unauthorized changes to software packages.

controls.name: control information leakage
controls.description: Opportunities for information leakage shall be prevented.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough risk assessment to identify potential information leakage points within the organization.
Implement data classification policies to ensure sensitive information is properly identified and protected.
Utilize encryption for data at rest and in transit to prevent unauthorized access and leakage.
Establish access controls and permissions to limit who can view or handle sensitive information.
Regularly review and update security policies and training programs to ensure all employees are aware of information leakage risks.

controls.name: outsourced software development
controls.description: Outsourced software development shall be supervised and monitored by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear contracts with third-party developers that outline security requirements and expectations.
Implement a monitoring system to regularly assess the security practices of outsourced development teams.
Conduct periodic audits of the outsourced software development processes to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
Provide training and resources to outsourced teams on the organization's security policies and procedures.
Maintain open communication channels for reporting security issues or concerns related to outsourced development.

controls.name: control of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Timely information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated, and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

deployment_points.name: Subscribe to vulnerability databases and threat intelligence feeds to stay informed about new vulnerabilities.
Conduct regular vulnerability assessments and penetration testing on all information systems.
Develop a risk assessment framework to evaluate the impact of identified vulnerabilities on the organization.
Implement a patch management process to ensure timely application of security updates and patches.
Document and communicate the findings of vulnerability assessments to relevant stakeholders for action.

controls_data.name: Reporting Information Security Events And Weaknesses

controls.name: reporting information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

deployment_points.name: Establish a clear reporting procedure for employees to follow when they identify security events.
Train all staff on the importance of timely reporting and the specific channels to use for reporting incidents.
Implement a centralized logging system to capture and track reported security events.
Designate a response team responsible for evaluating and addressing reported security events.
Regularly review and update the reporting procedures to ensure they remain effective and user-friendly.

controls.name: reporting security weaknesses
controls.description: All employees, contractors and third party users of information systems and services shall be required to note and report any observed or suspected security weaknesses in systems or services.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate a clear policy outlining the process for reporting security weaknesses.
Conduct training sessions to educate employees and contractors on recognizing and reporting security weaknesses.
Create an anonymous reporting mechanism to encourage individuals to report weaknesses without fear of reprisal.
Establish a review process to assess reported weaknesses and prioritize remediation efforts.
Communicate the outcomes of reported weaknesses to all staff to promote transparency and learning.

controls.name: responsibilities and procedures
controls.description: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective, and orderly response to information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Define and document roles and responsibilities for incident response within the organization.
Develop an incident response plan that outlines procedures for detecting, responding to, and recovering from security incidents.
Conduct regular training and simulation exercises to ensure staff are familiar with incident response procedures.
Establish communication protocols for informing stakeholders during and after an incident.
Review and update the incident response plan regularly based on lessons learned from past incidents.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents
controls.description: There shall be mechanisms in place to enable the types, volumes, and costs of information security incidents to be quantified and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Implement a tracking system to log all information security incidents, including their types and impacts.
Analyze incident data to identify trends and common vulnerabilities that need addressing.
Develop metrics to quantify the costs associated with information security incidents for better resource allocation.
Share findings from incident analyses with relevant stakeholders to promote awareness and preventive measures.
Regularly review and refine the mechanisms for tracking and analyzing incidents to improve effectiveness.

controls.name: collection of evidence
controls.description: Where a follow-up action against a person or organization after an information security incident involves legal action (either civil or criminal), evidence shall be collected, retained, and presented to conform to the rules for evidence laid down in the relevant jurisdiction(s).

deployment_points.name: Establish procedures for the proper collection and preservation of evidence following a security incident.
Train incident response teams on legal requirements for evidence collection and handling.
Document all actions taken during the incident response to maintain a clear chain of custody for evidence.
Collaborate with legal counsel to ensure compliance with jurisdictional rules regarding evidence.
Regularly review and update evidence collection procedures to align with best practices and legal standards.

controls_data.name: Information Security Aspects Of Business Continuity Management

controls.name: including information security in the business continuity management process
controls.description: A managed process shall be developed and maintained for business continuity throughout the organization that addresses the information security requirements needed for the organizationΓÇÖs business continuity.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security considerations into the overall business continuity management framework.
Conduct a business impact analysis to identify critical functions and the information security requirements for each.
Develop and document business continuity plans that include specific information security measures.
Regularly test and update business continuity plans to ensure they remain effective and relevant.
Train staff on their roles in maintaining business continuity with a focus on information security.

controls.name: business continuity and risk assessment
controls.description: Events that can cause interruptions to business processes shall be identified, along with the probability and impact of such interruptions and their consequences for information security.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive risk assessment to identify potential events that could disrupt business processes.
Evaluate the likelihood and impact of identified risks on business operations and information security.
Prioritize risks based on their potential impact and develop mitigation strategies for the highest risks.
Document findings and ensure they are communicated to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making.
Regularly review and update the risk assessment to reflect changes in the business environment and emerging threats.

controls.name: developing and implementing continuity plans including information security
controls.description: Plans shall be developed and implemented to maintain or restore operations and ensure availability of information at the required level and in the required time scales following interruption to, or failure of, critical business processes.

deployment_points.name: Identify critical business processes and the information required to support them, ensuring that all stakeholders are involved in the planning process.
Develop detailed continuity plans that outline specific actions to be taken in the event of an interruption, including roles and responsibilities for team members.
Implement the plans by training staff and conducting awareness sessions to ensure everyone understands their roles during a disruption.
Establish a schedule for regular testing of the continuity plans through simulations or drills to evaluate their effectiveness and identify areas for improvement.
Review and update the plans periodically to reflect changes in business processes, technology, or regulatory requirements.

controls.name: business continuity planning framework
controls.description: A single framework of business continuity plans shall be maintained to ensure all plans are consistent, to consistently address information security requirements, and to identify priorities for testing and maintenance.

deployment_points.name: Create a centralized repository for all business continuity plans to ensure easy access and consistency across the organization.
Develop a standardized template for business continuity plans that includes sections for information security requirements and testing priorities.
Assign a dedicated team to oversee the maintenance of the framework, ensuring that all plans are regularly reviewed and updated as necessary.
Conduct regular training sessions for staff on the importance of the framework and how to utilize the plans effectively during a crisis.
Establish metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of the framework and make adjustments based on feedback and testing outcomes.

controls.name: testing, maintaining and re-assessing business continuity plans
controls.description: Business continuity plans shall be tested and updated regularly to ensure that they are up to date and effective.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular testing of business continuity plans, including tabletop exercises and full-scale drills, to assess their effectiveness.
Document the results of each test, noting any issues encountered and areas for improvement.
Update the business continuity plans based on the outcomes of tests and any changes in business operations or technology.
Ensure that all staff are aware of the testing schedule and their roles during exercises to promote engagement and preparedness.
Review and revise the testing methodology periodically to incorporate best practices and lessons learned from previous tests.

controls.name: identification of applicable legislation
controls.description: All relevant statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements and the organizationΓÇÖs approach to meet these requirements shall be explicitly defined, documented, and kept up to date for each information system and the organization.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive review of all applicable laws, regulations, and contractual obligations relevant to the organizationΓÇÖs information systems.
Document the identified requirements in a centralized compliance register that is accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Assign responsibility for monitoring changes in legislation to a designated compliance officer or team to ensure ongoing compliance.
Regularly review and update the compliance register to reflect any changes in legal requirements or organizational practices.
Provide training to staff on the importance of compliance and the specific requirements that apply to their roles.

controls.name: intellectual property rights (ipr)
controls.description: Appropriate procedures shall be implemented to ensure compliance with legislative, regulatory, and contractual requirements on the use of material in respect of which there may be intellectual property rights and on the use of proprietary software products.

deployment_points.name: Develop and implement a policy that outlines the organizationΓÇÖs approach to managing intellectual property rights and compliance with relevant laws.
Conduct training sessions for employees on the importance of intellectual property rights and the procedures for using proprietary materials.
Establish a process for reviewing and approving the use of third-party materials to ensure compliance with licensing agreements.
Maintain a record of all proprietary software and materials used within the organization, including licensing information and expiration dates.
Regularly audit the use of intellectual property to ensure compliance and address any violations promptly.

controls.name: protection of organizational records
controls.description: Important records shall be protected from loss, destruction and falsification, in accordance with statutory, regulatory, contractual, and business requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify and classify all organizational records based on their importance and the legal requirements for their protection.
Implement access controls to restrict access to sensitive records to authorized personnel only.
Establish backup procedures to ensure that records are regularly backed up and can be restored in case of loss or destruction.
Develop a retention policy that outlines how long different types of records should be kept and the process for their secure disposal.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the protection measures and address any identified weaknesses.

controls.name: data protection and privacy of personal information
controls.description: Data protection and privacy shall be ensured as required in relevant legislation, regulations, and, if applicable, contractual clauses.

deployment_points.name: Develop a data protection policy that outlines the organizationΓÇÖs commitment to protecting personal information in compliance with relevant laws.
Conduct a data inventory to identify all personal information held by the organization and assess the risks associated with its processing.
Implement technical and organizational measures to protect personal data, including encryption, access controls, and data minimization practices.
Provide training to employees on data protection principles and their responsibilities in handling personal information.
Establish a process for responding to data breaches, including notification procedures and remediation steps.

controls.name: prevention of misuse of information processing facilities
controls.description: Users shall be deterred from using information processing facilities for unauthorized purposes.

deployment_points.name: Develop and communicate a clear acceptable use policy that outlines the permitted and prohibited uses of information processing facilities.
Implement technical controls such as monitoring and logging to detect unauthorized access or misuse of facilities.
Conduct regular training sessions to educate users about the acceptable use policy and the consequences of violations.
Establish a reporting mechanism for users to report suspected misuse or violations of the policy.
Regularly review and update the acceptable use policy to ensure it remains relevant and effective.

controls.name: regulation of cryptographic controls
controls.description: Cryptographic controls shall be used in compliance with all relevant agreements, laws, and regulations.

deployment_points.name: Develop a cryptographic policy that outlines the organizationΓÇÖs approach to using cryptographic controls in compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
Identify all systems and data that require cryptographic protection and determine the appropriate cryptographic methods to be used.
Implement technical controls to enforce the use of cryptographic measures, including encryption for data at rest and in transit.
Provide training to staff on the importance of cryptographic controls and how to implement them effectively.
Regularly review and update the cryptographic policy and practices to ensure compliance with evolving legal requirements.

controls.name: compliance with security policies and standards
controls.description: Managers shall ensure that all security procedures within their area of responsibility are carried out correctly to achieve compliance with security policies and standards.

deployment_points.name: Develop a checklist of security procedures that must be followed within each department to ensure compliance with organizational policies.
Assign responsibility to managers for overseeing the implementation of security procedures and conducting regular reviews.
Provide training to employees on security policies and the importance of compliance in their daily activities.
Establish a reporting mechanism for employees to report non-compliance or security incidents.
Conduct regular audits to assess compliance with security policies and take corrective actions as necessary.

controls.name: technical compliance checking
controls.description: Information systems shall be regularly checked for compliance with security implementation standards.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular compliance checks of information systems to ensure adherence to security implementation standards.
Develop a checklist based on the security standards that need to be verified during each compliance check.
Assign qualified personnel to conduct the compliance checks and provide them with necessary training on the standards.
Document the findings of each compliance check, including any non-compliance issues and corrective actions taken.
Review and update the compliance checking process periodically to incorporate changes in security standards and improve effectiveness.

controls.name: information systems audit
controls.description: Audit requirements and activities involving checks on operational systems shall be carefully planned and agreed to minimize the risk of disruptions to business processes.

deployment_points.name: Define the scope and objectives of the audit, ensuring alignment with business processes and operational requirements.
Create a detailed audit plan that outlines the timeline, resources needed, and specific activities to be performed during the audit.
Communicate the audit plan to all relevant stakeholders to ensure their awareness and agreement, minimizing potential disruptions.
Execute the audit according to the plan, documenting all findings and any deviations from expected outcomes.
Conduct a post-audit review meeting with stakeholders to discuss findings, recommendations, and any necessary follow-up actions.

controls.name: protection of information systems audit tools
controls.description: Access to information systems audit tools shall be protected to prevent any possible misuse or compromise.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict the use of audit tools to authorized personnel only, using role-based access management.
Regularly review and update the list of authorized users to ensure that only current personnel have access to the audit tools.
Utilize encryption and secure storage methods for audit tools to protect them from unauthorized access and potential compromise.
Monitor and log access to audit tools to detect any unauthorized attempts to use or access these tools.
Provide training to authorized users on the proper use and handling of audit tools to prevent misuse and ensure compliance with security policies.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

deployment_points.name: Define a comprehensive set of information security policies that cover all relevant aspects of security management.
Obtain formal approval from senior management to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and compliance requirements.
Publish the approved policies in accessible formats and locations, such as the company intranet or employee handbooks.
Communicate the policies to all employees and relevant external parties through training sessions, emails, and meetings to ensure understanding and compliance.
Establish a process for ongoing communication and updates regarding the policies to keep all stakeholders informed of any changes.

controls.name: review of the policies for information security
controls.description: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular review intervals for the information security policies, such as annually or bi-annually, to ensure they remain relevant.
Identify triggers for unscheduled reviews, such as significant organizational changes, incidents, or regulatory updates.
Assemble a review team comprising stakeholders from various departments to assess the policies' effectiveness and relevance.
Document the findings of each review, including any necessary updates or changes to the policies.
Communicate the results of the review and any changes made to all employees and relevant external parties to ensure continued awareness and compliance.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

deployment_points.name: Identify all roles within the organization that have responsibilities related to information security, including IT, HR, and management.
Clearly define the specific information security responsibilities for each role to avoid ambiguity and overlap.
Document the roles and responsibilities in an accessible format, such as a policy document or organizational chart.
Communicate the defined roles and responsibilities to all employees to ensure understanding and accountability.
Regularly review and update the roles and responsibilities to reflect changes in the organization or security landscape.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organizationΓÇÖs assets.

deployment_points.name: Identify key processes and functions within the organization that require segregation of duties to mitigate risks.
Define and document the specific roles and responsibilities that should be separated to prevent conflicts of interest.
Implement access controls and system configurations that enforce the segregation of duties in relevant systems and processes.
Train employees on the importance of segregation of duties and the specific practices in place to uphold this principle.
Regularly audit and review the segregation of duties to ensure compliance and address any identified issues.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and industry associations, that the organization should maintain contact with.
Establish a list of key contacts within these authorities, including their roles and contact information.
Develop a communication plan that outlines how and when to engage with these authorities, including reporting incidents or seeking guidance.
Designate specific personnel within the organization responsible for maintaining these contacts and ensuring effective communication.
Regularly review and update the contact list and communication plan to reflect any changes in personnel or authority requirements.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, forums, and professional associations related to information security that the organization can engage with.
Establish a list of key contacts within these groups, including their roles and contact information.
Develop a strategy for participation in these groups, including attending meetings, conferences, and contributing to discussions.
Designate personnel responsible for maintaining relationships with these groups and ensuring the organization benefits from shared knowledge and resources.
Regularly review and update the list of contacts and participation strategies to ensure continued relevance and engagement.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be addressed in project management, regardless of the type of the project.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security requirements into the project management framework and methodologies used within the organization.
Define specific security roles and responsibilities for project teams to ensure accountability for security considerations.
Conduct risk assessments for each project to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities.
Develop and implement security plans that outline the measures to be taken to protect information throughout the project lifecycle.
Review and evaluate the effectiveness of security measures in completed projects to inform future project management practices.

controls.name: mobile device policy
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile devices.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive mobile device policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and responsibilities for employees.
Implement technical controls such as encryption, remote wipe capabilities, and access restrictions to protect sensitive data on mobile devices.
Provide training to employees on the mobile device policy and best practices for securing their devices.
Regularly review and update the mobile device policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor compliance with the mobile device policy through audits and assessments to ensure adherence and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: teleworking
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

deployment_points.name: Develop a teleworking policy that outlines security requirements, acceptable use, and responsibilities for employees working remotely.
Implement security measures such as VPNs, secure access controls, and data encryption to protect information accessed from teleworking sites.
Provide training to employees on the teleworking policy and best practices for securing information while working remotely.
Regularly review and update the teleworking policy to address new risks and changes in the remote work environment.
Monitor compliance with the teleworking policy through assessments and feedback to ensure ongoing security and effectiveness.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

deployment_points.name: Establish a background verification policy that outlines the types of checks to be conducted based on the role and information access level.
Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations regarding background checks, including privacy and discrimination laws.
Implement a standardized process for conducting background checks, including documentation and record-keeping.
Train HR personnel and hiring managers on the background verification process and the importance of security in hiring decisions.
Regularly review and update the background verification policy and processes to ensure they remain effective and compliant with changing regulations.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The contractual agreements with employees and contractors shall state their and the organizationΓÇÖs responsibilities for information security.

deployment_points.name: Draft clear contractual agreements that outline both employee and organizational responsibilities regarding information security.
Ensure that all contracts are reviewed by legal and compliance teams to meet regulatory requirements.
Communicate the terms and conditions to all new hires during the onboarding process.
Maintain a repository of all signed contracts for easy access and auditing purposes.
Regularly review and update the terms to reflect changes in policies or regulations.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate clear information security policies and procedures to all employees and contractors.
Conduct regular training sessions to ensure understanding and compliance with these policies.
Implement a monitoring system to track adherence to information security practices.
Establish a feedback mechanism for employees to report challenges or suggestions regarding security practices.
Hold management accountable for enforcing compliance and addressing violations.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive training program that covers information security awareness tailored to different job functions.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to keep employees informed of new threats and policies.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to enhance engagement.
Track attendance and completion rates to ensure all employees participate in the training.
Evaluate the effectiveness of training through assessments and feedback to continuously improve the program.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: There shall be a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who have committed an information security breach.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal disciplinary policy that outlines the consequences of information security breaches.
Communicate the disciplinary process to all employees during onboarding and through regular reminders.
Ensure that the process includes clear steps for investigation and appeals to maintain fairness.
Train management on how to implement the disciplinary process consistently and fairly.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary policy to ensure it remains effective and compliant with legal standards.

controls.name: termination or change of employment responsibilities
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor and enforced.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the information security responsibilities that persist post-termination or change of employment.
Communicate these responsibilities clearly to employees during exit interviews or transition meetings.
Implement a process to revoke access to systems and data immediately upon termination.
Ensure that all departing employees sign an acknowledgment of their ongoing responsibilities regarding information security.
Regularly review and update the policies to reflect any changes in organizational structure or legal requirements.

controls.name: inventory of assets
controls.description: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive assessment to identify all information assets and processing facilities within the organization.
Create and maintain an up-to-date inventory that includes details such as asset type, owner, and location.
Implement a regular review process to ensure the inventory remains accurate and complete.
Utilize asset management software to streamline the tracking and management of assets.
Train staff on the importance of asset management and their role in maintaining the inventory.

controls.name: ownership of assets
controls.description: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

deployment_points.name: Assign clear ownership for each asset listed in the inventory to ensure accountability.
Document the responsibilities of asset owners regarding the protection and management of their assets.
Regularly review ownership assignments to ensure they are current and reflect organizational changes.
Communicate ownership responsibilities to all relevant stakeholders to promote awareness.
Implement a process for transferring ownership when employees leave or change roles.

controls.name: acceptable use of assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear acceptable use policy that outlines the rules for using organizational assets and information.
Communicate the policy to all employees and contractors during onboarding and through regular training.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the acceptable use policy.
Establish consequences for violations of the policy to deter misuse of assets.
Regularly review and update the acceptable use policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal process for the return of organizational assets upon termination or contract completion.
Communicate the asset return policy to all employees and external users during onboarding.
Create a checklist of assets to be returned to ensure completeness during the exit process.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the return of assets and follow up on outstanding items.
Regularly review the asset return process to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes information based on legal, value, criticality, and sensitivity criteria.
Train employees on how to classify information correctly according to the established scheme.
Implement a process for regularly reviewing and updating information classifications as needed.
Ensure that classified information is handled according to its classification level, including access controls and storage requirements.
Document and communicate the classification scheme to all employees to promote compliance.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information classification scheme that defines categories and sensitivity levels of information.
Create labelling procedures that specify how information should be marked based on its classification level.
Train employees on the importance of information labelling and the procedures to follow for consistent application.
Implement a review process to ensure that information is labelled correctly and consistently across the organization.
Regularly update labelling procedures to reflect changes in the classification scheme or regulatory requirements.

controls.name: handling of assets
controls.description: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear procedures for the handling of assets based on their classification, including storage, access, and transfer protocols.
Identify and categorize all assets according to the information classification scheme to ensure appropriate handling.
Train staff on the procedures for handling assets, emphasizing the importance of compliance with the classification scheme.
Monitor and audit asset handling practices to ensure adherence to established procedures and identify areas for improvement.
Review and update handling procedures regularly to align with changes in the classification scheme or organizational policies.

controls.name: management of removable media
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop procedures for the secure management of removable media, including encryption and access controls based on classification levels.
Classify all removable media according to the organization's information classification scheme to determine handling requirements.
Train employees on the proper use and management of removable media, including security measures and reporting incidents.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the distribution and return of removable media to prevent loss or unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update removable media management procedures to ensure they remain effective and compliant with security policies.

controls.name: disposal of media
controls.description: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish formal procedures for the secure disposal of media, including methods such as shredding or degaussing.
Classify media according to the information classification scheme to determine the appropriate disposal method.
Train staff on disposal procedures to ensure compliance and understanding of the importance of secure media disposal.
Maintain a log of disposed media, including details of the media type, disposal method, and personnel involved in the process.
Regularly review and update disposal procedures to ensure they meet current security standards and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: physical media transfer
controls.description: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation.

deployment_points.name: Develop procedures for the secure transportation of media, including the use of tamper-evident packaging and secure transport methods.
Classify media according to the information classification scheme to determine the level of protection required during transfer.
Train employees on secure media transfer procedures, emphasizing the importance of protecting sensitive information.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the movement of media during transportation to ensure accountability.
Regularly review and update transfer procedures to address emerging threats and ensure compliance with security policies.

controls.name: access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established, documented and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that outlines user access rights based on business needs and security requirements.
Document the access control policy and ensure it is easily accessible to all relevant stakeholders within the organization.
Conduct regular reviews of the access control policy to ensure it remains aligned with business objectives and security standards.
Train employees on the access control policy, including their responsibilities and the importance of adhering to it.
Implement a process for monitoring and auditing access control compliance to identify and address any violations.

controls.name: access to networks and network services
controls.description: Users shall only be provided with access to the network and network services that they have been specifically authorized to use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a user access request process that requires formal approval for access to network services based on job roles.
Implement technical controls to enforce access restrictions, ensuring users can only access authorized network resources.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure they remain appropriate and revoke access for users who no longer require it.
Train employees on the importance of access control and the procedures for requesting and managing access to network services.
Monitor network access logs to detect unauthorized access attempts and take corrective actions as necessary.

controls.name: user registration and de-registration
controls.description: A formal user registration and de-registration process shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal user registration process that includes identity verification and approval for new user accounts.
Implement a de-registration process to promptly revoke access rights for users who leave the organization or change roles.
Maintain a record of all user registrations and de-registrations to ensure accountability and compliance.
Train staff on the registration and de-registration processes to ensure they understand their roles and responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the registration and de-registration processes to align with changes in organizational policies.

controls.name: user access provisioning
controls.description: A formal user access provisioning process shall be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal access provisioning process that includes criteria for assigning and revoking access rights based on user roles.
Implement a system for tracking access rights assignments and changes to ensure accurate record-keeping.
Train employees on the access provisioning process, emphasizing the importance of following established procedures.
Conduct regular audits of access rights to ensure compliance with the provisioning process and identify any discrepancies.
Review and update the access provisioning process regularly to adapt to changes in technology and organizational needs.

controls.name: management of privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for the management of privileged access rights, outlining criteria for granting and revoking such access.
Implement technical controls to restrict privileged access to only those users who require it for their job functions.
Train staff on the importance of managing privileged access and the procedures for requesting and using such rights.
Regularly review and audit privileged access rights to ensure compliance with the management policy and identify any unauthorized access.
Update the privileged access management policy and procedures regularly to reflect changes in organizational structure and security requirements.

controls.name: management of secret authentication information of users
controls.description: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for the allocation and management of secret authentication information, including roles and responsibilities.
Implement a secure method for generating and distributing secret authentication information to users.
Maintain a centralized repository for tracking the allocation and status of secret authentication information.
Regularly review and update the management process to ensure compliance with security policies and best practices.
Train users on the importance of safeguarding their secret authentication information and the procedures for reporting any security incidents.

controls.name: review of user access rights
controls.description: Asset owners shall review usersΓÇÖ access rights at regular intervals.

deployment_points.name: Define a schedule for regular reviews of user access rights, such as quarterly or bi-annually.
Assign asset owners the responsibility to conduct these reviews and ensure they have the necessary tools and information.
Document the review process, including criteria for access rights and any changes made during the review.
Implement a mechanism for users to request changes to their access rights and for asset owners to approve or deny these requests.
Report the results of the access rights reviews to management and take corrective actions for any discrepancies found.

controls.name: removal or adjustment of access rights
controls.description: The access rights of all employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal procedure for the timely removal or adjustment of access rights upon termination or change of employment status.
Ensure that HR and IT departments are coordinated to promptly communicate changes in employment status.
Implement automated systems to revoke access rights immediately upon termination or change of role.
Conduct regular audits to verify that access rights have been appropriately removed or adjusted as per the established procedures.
Maintain records of access rights changes for compliance and auditing purposes.

controls.name: use of secret authentication information
controls.description: Users shall be required to follow the organizationΓÇÖs practices in the use of secret authentication information.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document clear guidelines on the proper use of secret authentication information for all users.
Provide training sessions to educate users on the importance of following these practices and the risks of non-compliance.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure adherence to the established practices regarding secret authentication information.
Establish a reporting process for users to report any suspected misuse or compromise of secret authentication information.
Regularly review and update the guidelines to reflect changes in technology and security threats.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop an access control policy that clearly defines user roles and the corresponding access levels required for information and application systems.
Implement technical controls to enforce the access restrictions defined in the policy, such as role-based access control (RBAC).
Regularly review and update the access control policy to ensure it remains relevant and effective against emerging threats.
Train users on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to access restrictions.
Monitor access logs to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

deployment_points.name: Define secure log-on procedures that include multi-factor authentication where appropriate.
Implement technical solutions to enforce these log-on procedures across all systems and applications.
Regularly test and update the log-on procedures to address any vulnerabilities or weaknesses.
Provide user training on the secure log-on procedures and the importance of maintaining log-in security.
Monitor log-on attempts and establish alerts for suspicious activities or repeated failed log-in attempts.

controls.name: password management system
controls.description: Password management systems shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

deployment_points.name: Implement an interactive password management system that enforces strong password policies, including complexity and length requirements.
Provide users with guidance on creating secure passwords and the importance of password uniqueness.
Regularly review and update the password management system to incorporate best practices and address security vulnerabilities.
Monitor password usage and implement measures to detect and respond to weak or compromised passwords.
Educate users on the importance of changing passwords regularly and provide reminders for password updates.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs and assess their potential risks to system and application controls.
Develop a policy that restricts the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Implement logging and monitoring of all activities involving privileged utility programs to detect unauthorized use.
Provide training to authorized users on the proper use and risks associated with privileged utility programs.
Regularly review and audit the use of privileged utility programs to ensure compliance with the established policy.

controls.name: access control to program source code
controls.description: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

deployment_points.name: Establish a policy that defines who can access program source code and under what circumstances.
Implement access controls to restrict source code access to authorized personnel only, using role-based permissions.
Maintain an audit trail of all access to program source code to monitor for unauthorized access.
Regularly review access permissions to ensure they are appropriate and up-to-date.
Provide training to developers and authorized personnel on the importance of source code security and the risks of unauthorized access.

controls.name: policy on the use of cryptographic controls
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive policy outlining the use of cryptographic controls for protecting sensitive information.
Identify the types of information that require cryptographic protection and the appropriate cryptographic methods to be used.
Implement the policy across the organization, ensuring all relevant personnel are aware of and trained on its requirements.
Regularly review and update the cryptographic policy to adapt to new threats and technological advancements.
Monitor compliance with the cryptographic policy and conduct audits to ensure effective implementation.

controls.name: key management
controls.description: A policy on the use, protection and lifetime of cryptographic keys shall be developed and implemented through their whole lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive key management policy that outlines the procedures for key generation, distribution, storage, and destruction.
Implement a secure key storage solution, such as a hardware security module (HSM), to protect cryptographic keys from unauthorized access.
Establish a key lifecycle management process that includes regular audits and reviews of key usage and access logs.
Train personnel on key management best practices and the importance of safeguarding cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle.
Regularly update the key management policy to reflect changes in technology, threats, and organizational requirements.

controls.name: physical security perimeter
