controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

deployment_points.name: Identify and map out all areas containing sensitive or critical information to establish clear security perimeters.
Install physical barriers such as fences, walls, or gates to delineate the security perimeter and restrict unauthorized access.
Implement surveillance systems, such as CCTV cameras, to monitor the security perimeter and detect any unauthorized entry attempts.
Establish access control measures, including security personnel and identification checks, at all entry points to the defined perimeter.
Regularly review and update the security perimeter based on changes in facility layout or security threats.

controls.name: physical entry controls
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

deployment_points.name: Implement access control systems, such as key cards or biometric scanners, to restrict entry to secure areas.
Maintain an up-to-date list of authorized personnel who are permitted access to secure areas and regularly review this list.
Train security staff on entry control procedures and the importance of verifying the identity of individuals seeking access.
Establish visitor management protocols, including sign-in procedures and escort requirements for non-authorized personnel.
Conduct regular audits of entry control systems to ensure compliance and identify any potential vulnerabilities.

controls.name: securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in offices, rooms, and facilities that require physical security measures.
Install locks, security doors, and window bars to enhance physical security in sensitive areas.
Implement an alarm system to alert personnel of unauthorized access or breaches in security.
Ensure that all security measures are regularly tested and maintained to ensure their effectiveness.
Develop and communicate emergency response plans for incidents related to physical security breaches.

controls.name: protecting against external and environmental threats
controls.description: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential external and environmental threats to the facility.
Implement structural reinforcements, such as flood barriers or seismic bracing, to protect against natural disasters.
Install fire suppression systems and ensure that fire exits are clearly marked and accessible.
Develop and regularly test disaster recovery and business continuity plans to address potential incidents.
Train employees on emergency procedures and the importance of reporting any environmental hazards.

controls.name: working in secure areas
controls.description: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear procedures for employees working in secure areas, including access protocols and safety measures.
Provide training to employees on the specific security requirements and responsibilities when working in secure areas.
Implement a monitoring system to ensure compliance with established procedures and identify any deviations.
Regularly review and update procedures based on feedback from employees and changes in security threats.
Establish a reporting mechanism for employees to report security incidents or concerns while working in secure areas.

controls.name: delivery and loading areas
controls.description: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Designate specific delivery and loading areas that are separate from sensitive information processing facilities.
Implement access control measures, such as security personnel or electronic gates, to monitor and restrict access to delivery areas.
Train staff on procedures for receiving deliveries, including verification of delivery personnel and inspection of packages.
Install surveillance cameras in delivery areas to monitor activities and deter unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update access control measures based on changes in delivery processes or security threats.

controls.name: equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a site assessment to determine the optimal location for equipment to minimize exposure to environmental threats.
Install physical barriers, such as locked cabinets or cages, to protect sensitive equipment from unauthorized access.
Ensure that equipment is placed away from windows, doors, and other potential points of vulnerability.
Implement environmental controls, such as temperature and humidity monitoring, to protect equipment from environmental hazards.
Regularly review equipment siting and protection measures to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.

controls.name: supporting utilities
controls.description: Equipment shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

deployment_points.name: Install uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) to provide backup power to critical equipment during outages.
Regularly test and maintain UPS systems to ensure they are functioning properly and can support equipment during power failures.
Implement redundancy for critical utilities, such as backup generators, to minimize the impact of utility failures.
Monitor utility performance and establish alerts for any disruptions to proactively address potential issues.
Develop and communicate contingency plans for responding to utility failures and ensuring continuity of operations.

controls.name: cabling security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

deployment_points.name: Route cabling through secure pathways, such as conduits or cable trays, to minimize exposure to unauthorized access.
Use tamper-evident seals and secure enclosures for cabling to prevent interception or damage.
Regularly inspect cabling for signs of wear, damage, or tampering and address any issues promptly.
Implement monitoring systems to detect unauthorized access or interference with cabling.
Train personnel on the importance of cabling security and best practices for maintaining the integrity of data transmission.

controls.name: equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be correctly maintained to ensure its continued availability and integrity.

deployment_points.name: Establish a maintenance schedule for all equipment, detailing frequency and types of maintenance required.
Assign qualified personnel to perform maintenance tasks and ensure they are trained on the specific equipment.
Document all maintenance activities, including dates, actions taken, and any issues identified during maintenance.
Implement a tracking system to monitor equipment performance and maintenance history to identify trends or recurring issues.
Review and update maintenance procedures regularly to incorporate lessons learned and changes in equipment or technology.

controls.name: removal of assets
controls.description: Equipment, information or software shall not be taken off-site without prior authorization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal policy outlining the process for requesting authorization to remove assets from the premises.
Create a standardized asset removal form that includes details such as the asset type, purpose of removal, and duration.
Designate an approval authority responsible for reviewing and granting or denying asset removal requests.
Maintain a log of all approved and denied requests to ensure accountability and traceability.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the asset removal policy and address any unauthorized removals.

controls.name: security of equipment and assets off-premises
controls.description: Security shall be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organizationΓÇÖs premises.

deployment_points.name: Assess the risks associated with off-site work and develop security measures tailored to those risks.
Provide employees with guidelines on securing equipment and assets when working off-premises, including physical security and data protection measures.
Implement encryption for sensitive data stored on portable devices to protect against unauthorized access.
Require employees to report any loss or theft of off-site assets immediately to ensure prompt response and mitigation.
Regularly review and update off-site security policies to adapt to changing risks and technologies.

controls.name: secure disposal or reuse of equipment
controls.description: All items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a secure disposal policy that outlines procedures for handling equipment containing sensitive data.
Use certified data destruction methods to ensure that all sensitive information is irretrievable before disposal or reuse.
Maintain records of all disposed or reused equipment, including the method of data destruction and the personnel involved.
Train staff on the importance of secure disposal practices and the potential risks of improper handling of sensitive data.
Conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with the secure disposal policy and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: unattended user equipment
controls.description: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

deployment_points.name: Implement automatic screen lock features on all devices to activate after a specified period of inactivity.
Educate users on the importance of securing their equipment when unattended, including locking screens and securing physical devices.
Establish a policy that requires users to log off or shut down equipment when leaving it unattended for extended periods.
Conduct regular training sessions to reinforce best practices for protecting unattended equipment and the risks of negligence.
Monitor compliance with the unattended equipment policy and address any violations through appropriate disciplinary measures.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen policy
controls.description: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

deployment_points.name: Develop and communicate a clear desk and clear screen policy that outlines expectations for maintaining a secure workspace.
Provide training to employees on the importance of keeping desks clear of sensitive information and securing screens when not in use.
Implement regular checks to ensure compliance with the clear desk and screen policy, providing feedback and corrective actions as necessary.
Encourage the use of secure storage solutions for sensitive documents and removable media to minimize exposure.
Review and update the policy periodically to address new security challenges and reinforce its importance.

controls.name: documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures shall be documented and made available to all users who need them.

deployment_points.name: Identify all critical operational procedures that require documentation and assign responsible personnel for each.
Create clear, concise, and accessible documentation for each procedure, ensuring it is easy to understand and follow.
Implement a centralized repository where all documented procedures can be stored and accessed by authorized users.
Regularly review and update documentation to reflect changes in processes, technology, or organizational structure.
Provide training sessions to ensure all users are familiar with the documented procedures and know how to access them.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management process that includes request submission, impact assessment, and approval workflows.
Designate a change advisory board (CAB) to review and approve significant changes affecting information security.
Document all changes, including the rationale, approval, and implementation details, to maintain a clear audit trail.
Conduct regular reviews of the change management process to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance with security policies.
Train staff on the change management process and the importance of controlling changes to protect information security.

controls.name: capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools to track resource usage across systems and applications in real-time.
Analyze historical data to identify trends in resource consumption and predict future capacity needs.
Establish thresholds for resource usage that trigger alerts for potential capacity issues before they impact performance.
Regularly review capacity management reports to inform decision-making regarding resource allocation and upgrades.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that capacity planning aligns with business objectives and anticipated growth.

controls.name: separation of development, testing and operational environments
controls.description: Development, testing, and operational environments shall be separated to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational environment.

deployment_points.name: Define clear boundaries between development, testing, and operational environments to prevent cross-contamination.
Implement access controls to restrict personnel from moving between environments without proper authorization.
Use separate servers and databases for development and testing to ensure that operational data remains secure.
Regularly audit the separation of environments to ensure compliance with established policies and identify any vulnerabilities.
Provide training to staff on the importance of maintaining separation and the risks associated with unauthorized access.

controls.name: controls against malware
controls.description: Detection, prevention and recovery controls to protect against malware shall be implemented, combined with appropriate user awareness.

deployment_points.name: Implement antivirus and anti-malware solutions on all endpoints and servers to detect and prevent malware infections.
Schedule regular updates for malware definitions and software to ensure protection against the latest threats.
Conduct user training sessions to raise awareness about malware threats and safe computing practices.
Establish a response plan for malware incidents, including isolation of infected systems and recovery procedures.
Regularly review and test the effectiveness of malware controls and update them based on emerging threats.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods of backups for all critical data.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of information and system images.
Store backup copies in a secure, offsite location to protect against data loss from physical disasters.
Regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure data can be recovered quickly and accurately when needed.
Review and update the backup policy periodically to adapt to changes in data volume and business requirements.

controls.name: event logging
controls.description: Event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events shall be produced, kept and regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Configure systems to generate logs for user activities, security events, and system errors to ensure comprehensive monitoring.
Establish a centralized logging system to collect and store logs from various sources for easier analysis.
Define log retention policies to determine how long logs should be kept based on compliance and operational needs.
Schedule regular reviews of logs to identify anomalies or security incidents that require further investigation.
Implement alerts for critical events to ensure timely responses to potential security threats.

controls.name: protection of log information
controls.description: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict who can view and modify log files, ensuring only authorized personnel have access.
Use encryption to protect log data both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access and tampering.
Regularly audit access to log files to detect any unauthorized attempts to view or alter log information.
Store logs in a secure location, separate from the systems generating the logs, to reduce the risk of tampering.
Establish a process for securely deleting logs that are no longer needed, in compliance with retention policies.

controls.name: administrator and operator logs
controls.description: System administrator and system operator activities shall be logged and the logs protected and regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Enable detailed logging for all administrative and operational activities on critical systems to ensure accountability.
Implement strict access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can access administrator and operator logs.
Schedule regular reviews of these logs to identify any unauthorized or suspicious activities that may indicate a security breach.
Use automated tools to analyze logs for patterns that may indicate misuse or misconfiguration of systems.
Retain logs for a defined period to comply with regulatory requirements and facilitate audits.

controls.name: clock synchronisation
controls.description: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronised to a single reference time source.

deployment_points.name: Identify a reliable time source, such as an NTP server, to serve as the reference for clock synchronization across all systems.
Configure all relevant information processing systems to synchronize their clocks with the designated time source at regular intervals.
Monitor synchronization status to ensure all systems maintain accurate time and address any discrepancies promptly.
Document the synchronization process and settings to ensure consistency and facilitate troubleshooting.
Regularly review and update the time synchronization configuration to adapt to changes in the network or system architecture.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented to control the installation of software on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a formal procedure for software installation that includes approval processes and testing requirements.
Restrict software installation privileges to authorized personnel only, ensuring that users cannot install unauthorized applications.
Implement a software inventory management system to track installed applications and their versions across all operational systems.
Regularly review installed software to ensure compliance with organizational policies and remove any unauthorized applications.
Provide training for personnel involved in software installation to ensure they understand the procedures and security implications.

controls.name: management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organizationΓÇÖs exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for regularly monitoring and assessing technical vulnerabilities in all information systems using automated tools.
Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all systems and software to facilitate vulnerability management efforts.
Evaluate the risk associated with identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation efforts based on potential impact.
Implement patches and updates promptly to address known vulnerabilities and reduce exposure to threats.
Document and communicate vulnerability management activities to ensure transparency and accountability within the organization.

controls.name: restrictions on software installation
controls.description: Rules governing the installation of software by users shall be established and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear policies that define which types of software can be installed by users and the approval process required.
Implement technical controls to enforce software installation restrictions, such as application whitelisting or software restriction policies.
Train users on the importance of adhering to software installation policies and the risks associated with unauthorized software.
Regularly review and update the software installation policies to reflect changes in technology and organizational needs.
Monitor compliance with installation policies and take corrective actions when violations occur.

controls.name: information systems audit controls
controls.description: Audit requirements and activities involving verification of operational systems shall be carefully planned and agreed to minimise disruptions to business processes.

deployment_points.name: Develop an audit plan that outlines the scope, objectives, and schedule for auditing operational systems to minimize business disruptions.
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure that audit activities are communicated and agreed upon in advance.
Use automated auditing tools to streamline the audit process and reduce the impact on system performance.
Document audit findings and recommendations clearly to facilitate follow-up actions and improvements.
Review and update the audit plan regularly to ensure it remains relevant and effective in addressing organizational needs.

controls.name: network controls
controls.description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a network management policy that outlines the roles and responsibilities for network security management.
Implement firewalls and intrusion detection systems to monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic.
Regularly update network devices and software to protect against vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Conduct periodic network security assessments to identify and mitigate risks associated with network configurations and access controls.
Train staff on network security best practices and incident response procedures to enhance overall network security awareness.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and management requirements of all network services shall be identified and included in network services agreements, whether these services are provided in-house or outsourced.

deployment_points.name: Define security requirements for all network services, including encryption, authentication, and access controls.
Include these security requirements in service level agreements (SLAs) with both internal and external service providers.
Regularly review and update SLAs to reflect changes in security standards and organizational needs.
Monitor compliance with SLAs through audits and performance assessments to ensure service providers meet security expectations.
Establish a process for reporting and addressing security incidents related to network services.

controls.name: segregation in networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize information services, users, and systems based on their security requirements and sensitivity levels.
Implement network segmentation using VLANs or subnets to separate different groups and limit access to sensitive information.
Apply access controls to ensure that only authorized users can access specific network segments.
Regularly review and update network segmentation strategies to adapt to changes in organizational structure or security threats.
Conduct training sessions for staff on the importance of network segregation and the procedures for accessing different network segments.

controls.name: information transfer policies and procedures
controls.description: Formal transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document formal policies and procedures for the secure transfer of information across all communication channels.
Implement encryption protocols for data in transit to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.
Train employees on the established policies and procedures to ensure compliance and awareness of secure information transfer practices.
Regularly review and update transfer policies to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor and log information transfers to detect and respond to any unauthorized or suspicious activities.

controls.name: agreements on information transfer
controls.description: Agreements shall address the secure transfer of business information between the organization and external parties.

deployment_points.name: Draft and implement agreements that specify security requirements for the transfer of information to and from external parties.
Include clauses in agreements that outline the responsibilities of both parties regarding data protection and incident response.
Regularly review and update agreements to ensure they reflect current security practices and regulatory requirements.
Conduct risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities in information transfer processes with external parties.
Establish a process for monitoring compliance with the agreements and addressing any breaches or violations.

controls.name: electronic messaging
controls.description: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected.

deployment_points.name: Implement encryption for all electronic messaging systems to protect the confidentiality and integrity of messages.
Establish policies for the acceptable use of electronic messaging, including guidelines for sharing sensitive information.
Train employees on secure messaging practices and the importance of protecting sensitive information in communications.
Regularly review and update electronic messaging systems to address vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Monitor electronic messaging for unauthorized access or data breaches and establish incident response procedures.

controls.name: confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organizationΓÇÖs needs for the protection of information shall be identified, regularly reviewed and documented.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of information that require confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements.
Draft and implement standard confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements for use with employees, contractors, and third parties.
Regularly review and update agreements to ensure they align with current legal standards and organizational policies.
Maintain a centralized repository for all signed agreements to facilitate tracking and compliance monitoring.
Train relevant staff on the importance of confidentiality agreements and the procedures for handling sensitive information.

controls.name: information security requirements analysis and specification
controls.description: The information security related requirements shall be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting information security requirements during the system development lifecycle.
Involve stakeholders from IT, security, and business units in the requirements gathering process to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Review and validate security requirements against industry standards and best practices to ensure adequacy.
Integrate security requirements into project plans and timelines to ensure they are addressed throughout the development process.
Conduct regular reviews of existing systems to identify and implement necessary security enhancements.

controls.name: securing application services on public networks
controls.description: Information involved in application services passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

deployment_points.name: Implement strong encryption protocols for all application services that transmit data over public networks.
Conduct regular security assessments of application services to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Establish access controls to limit who can access application services and the data they handle.
Monitor application services for suspicious activities and implement incident response procedures for potential breaches.
Train developers and IT staff on secure coding practices to prevent vulnerabilities in application services.

controls.name: protecting application services transactions
controls.description: Information involved in application service transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, mis-routing, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

deployment_points.name: Implement transaction validation mechanisms to ensure the integrity and authenticity of application service transactions.
Use encryption to protect transaction data both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access.
Establish logging and monitoring for all transactions to detect and respond to anomalies or unauthorized activities.
Regularly review and test transaction processing systems to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
Train staff on secure transaction processing practices and the importance of protecting transaction data.

controls.name: secure development policy
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal secure development policy that outlines security requirements and best practices for software development.
Communicate the secure development policy to all relevant stakeholders, including developers, project managers, and security teams.
Conduct training sessions to ensure that all personnel involved in development understand and can apply the secure development policy.
Regularly review and update the secure development policy to reflect changes in technology, threats, and organizational needs.
Implement a compliance monitoring process to ensure adherence to the secure development policy throughout the development lifecycle.

controls.name: system change control procedures
controls.description: Changes to systems within the development lifecycle shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop formal change control procedures that define the process for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes to systems.
Ensure that all change requests are documented and include a risk assessment to evaluate potential impacts on security and functionality.
Establish a change control board (CCB) to review and approve significant changes before implementation.
Maintain a change log to track all changes made, including the rationale for each change and any associated testing results.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess the effectiveness of changes and identify any issues that may arise.

controls.name: technical review of applications after operating platform changes
controls.description: When operating platforms are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

deployment_points.name: Establish a protocol for conducting technical reviews of applications following any changes to the operating platform.
Identify business-critical applications that require review and prioritize them based on their importance to organizational operations.
Develop a testing plan that includes functional, performance, and security testing to assess the impact of the platform change on applications.
Document the results of the technical review and testing, including any identified issues and remediation steps taken.
Communicate findings to relevant stakeholders and ensure that any necessary adjustments are made to applications before they are put back into production.

controls.name: restrictions on changes to software packages
controls.description: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish guidelines that discourage unnecessary modifications to software packages and outline acceptable reasons for making changes.
Implement a formal approval process for any modifications to software packages, requiring justification and risk assessment.
Maintain a version control system to track all changes made to software packages, including who made the change and when.
Conduct regular audits of software packages to ensure compliance with the established restrictions and identify unauthorized changes.
Provide training to development teams on the importance of adhering to restrictions on software package modifications and the potential risks of non-compliance.

controls.name: secure system engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts.

deployment_points.name: Define and document secure system engineering principles that align with industry best practices and organizational security requirements.
Integrate secure engineering principles into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to ensure they are applied consistently across all projects.
Provide training and resources to development teams to ensure they understand and can effectively implement secure engineering principles.
Regularly review and update the secure engineering principles to adapt to new threats, technologies, and regulatory requirements.
Establish a process for evaluating compliance with secure engineering principles during project reviews and audits.

controls.name: secure development environment
controls.description: Organizations shall establish and appropriately protect secure development environments for system development and integration efforts that cover the entire system development lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Designate secure development environments that are isolated from production systems and have restricted access based on the principle of least privilege.
Implement security controls such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and access controls to protect the secure development environment.
Ensure that all development tools and software used in the secure environment are regularly updated and patched to mitigate vulnerabilities.
Conduct regular security assessments of the development environment to identify and remediate potential security risks.
Provide training to developers on secure coding practices and the importance of maintaining security within the development environment.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall supervise and monitor the activity of outsourced system development.

deployment_points.name: Establish a framework for selecting and evaluating third-party vendors for outsourced development based on their security practices and compliance.
Define clear contractual obligations regarding security requirements and monitoring for outsourced development activities.
Implement regular oversight and monitoring processes to assess the performance and security compliance of outsourced development teams.
Conduct periodic audits of outsourced development activities to ensure adherence to security policies and procedures.
Maintain open communication with outsourced teams to address security concerns and ensure alignment with organizational security objectives.

controls.name: system security testing
controls.description: Testing of security functionality shall be carried out during development.

deployment_points.name: Integrate security testing into the software development lifecycle, ensuring it is conducted at multiple stages of development.
Develop a comprehensive security testing plan that includes static code analysis, dynamic testing, and penetration testing.
Train development teams on security testing methodologies and tools to enhance their ability to identify vulnerabilities.
Document and track all security testing results, including identified vulnerabilities and remediation actions taken.
Establish a feedback loop to continuously improve security testing processes based on lessons learned from previous projects.

controls.name: system acceptance testing
controls.description: Acceptance testing programs and related criteria shall be established for new information systems, upgrades and new versions.

deployment_points.name: Define acceptance testing criteria that include functional, performance, and security requirements for new systems and upgrades.
Develop a structured acceptance testing program that outlines the testing process, roles, and responsibilities.
Involve relevant stakeholders, including end-users and security teams, in the acceptance testing process to ensure comprehensive evaluation.
Document acceptance testing results and obtain formal sign-off from stakeholders before deploying new systems or upgrades.
Review and refine acceptance testing criteria and processes based on feedback and lessons learned from previous testing efforts.

controls.name: protection of test data
controls.description: Test data shall be selected carefully, protected and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish guidelines for selecting test data that ensure it is representative of production data while minimizing exposure of sensitive information.
Implement access controls to restrict who can view and use test data, ensuring only authorized personnel have access.
Use data masking or anonymization techniques to protect sensitive information within test data sets.
Regularly review and audit access to test data to ensure compliance with protection policies and identify any unauthorized access.
Provide training to development and testing teams on the importance of protecting test data and the methods used to secure it.

controls.name: information security policy for supplier relationships
controls.description: Information security requirements for mitigating the risks associated with supplierΓÇÖs access to the organizationΓÇÖs assets shall be agreed with the supplier and documented.

deployment_points.name: Identify and document the specific information security requirements that suppliers must adhere to when accessing organizational assets.
Establish a formal agreement with each supplier that outlines the agreed-upon security requirements and responsibilities.
Ensure that the documented requirements are communicated to all relevant stakeholders within the organization and the supplier.
Regularly review and update the information security policy to reflect changes in risk assessments or supplier relationships.
Implement a process for monitoring compliance with the agreed security requirements and address any non-compliance issues promptly.

controls.name: addressing security within supplier agreements
controls.description: All relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier that may access, process, store, communicate, or provide IT infrastructure components for, the organizationΓÇÖs information.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify the information security requirements relevant to each supplier's access to organizational information.
Draft supplier agreements that explicitly include the identified information security requirements and expectations.
Ensure that all agreements are reviewed and approved by legal and compliance teams to mitigate potential risks.
Provide training to suppliers on the security requirements outlined in the agreements to ensure understanding and compliance.
Establish a review process to periodically assess the effectiveness of the security measures in place and update agreements as necessary.

controls.name: information and communication technology supply chain
controls.description: Agreements with suppliers shall include requirements to address the information security risks associated with information and communications technology services and product supply chain.

deployment_points.name: Identify the specific information security risks associated with the ICT supply chain relevant to your organization.
Develop and include specific security requirements in supplier agreements that address these identified risks.
Ensure that suppliers are aware of their responsibilities regarding the security of the ICT services and products they provide.
Implement a monitoring system to regularly assess supplier compliance with the security requirements in the agreements.
Review and update the agreements periodically to reflect changes in technology and emerging security threats.

controls.name: monitoring and review of supplier services
controls.description: Organizations shall regularly monitor, review and audit supplier service delivery.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular monitoring and review of supplier service delivery against agreed performance and security metrics.
Develop a checklist or framework for auditing supplier services to ensure compliance with contractual obligations.
Assign specific personnel or teams responsible for conducting the monitoring and review activities.
Document findings from monitoring and audits, and communicate results to relevant stakeholders for transparency.
Implement corrective actions for any identified deficiencies in supplier service delivery and track their resolution.

controls.name: managing changes to supplier services
controls.description: Changes to the provision of services by suppliers, including maintaining and improving existing information security policies, procedures and controls, shall be managed, taking account of the criticality of business information, systems and processes involved and re-assessment of risks.

deployment_points.name: Develop a change management process that includes assessing the impact of changes in supplier services on information security.
Require suppliers to submit change requests that detail the nature of the changes and their potential impact on security.
Conduct risk assessments for each proposed change to determine necessary adjustments to security policies and controls.
Communicate any approved changes to all relevant stakeholders within the organization and the supplier.
Monitor the implementation of changes to ensure they are executed as planned and evaluate their effectiveness post-implementation.

controls_data.name: Management Of Information Security Incidents And Improvements

controls.name: responsibilities and procedures
controls.description: Management responsibilities and procedures shall be established to ensure a quick, effective and orderly response to information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Define clear roles and responsibilities for incident response within the organization, including a designated incident response team.
Develop and document incident response procedures that outline steps to be taken in the event of a security incident.
Conduct training sessions for all employees to ensure they understand their roles in the incident response process.
Establish communication protocols for reporting incidents to the appropriate management channels quickly.
Regularly review and test the incident response procedures to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: reporting information security events
controls.description: Information security events shall be reported through appropriate management channels as quickly as possible.

Create a simple and accessible reporting mechanism for users to submit their observations.
Ensure that all reported weaknesses are logged and tracked for follow-up and resolution.
Regularly review reported weaknesses to identify patterns and implement preventive measures.

controls.name: assessment of and decision on information security events

Implement a systematic process for documenting the assessment of each reported event.
Ensure timely decision-making regarding the classification of events as incidents to facilitate appropriate responses.
Review and refine the assessment process regularly to improve accuracy and efficiency.

controls.name: response to information security incidents

Conduct regular training and simulation exercises to prepare the incident response team for real incidents.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents

deployment_points.name: Establish a dedicated incident response team to analyze security incidents and document findings.
Create a centralized repository for incident reports and lessons learned to facilitate knowledge sharing.
Conduct regular training sessions for staff on the insights gained from past incidents to enhance awareness.
Implement a feedback loop where incident analysis informs updates to security policies and procedures.
Schedule periodic reviews of incident data to identify trends and proactively address potential vulnerabilities.

controls.name: collection of evidence

controls.name: planning information security continuity

Establish a review process to evaluate the effectiveness of implemented controls and make necessary adjustments.

controls.name: verify, review and evaluate information security continuity

Implement redundant systems and infrastructure to ensure continuous operation during failures.

Document the architecture of redundant systems to facilitate maintenance and updates.
Establish monitoring systems to detect failures in real-time and trigger failover processes.

controls_data.name: Compliance With Legal And Contractual Requirements

controls.name: protection of records

Review and update protection measures regularly to adapt to evolving threats and compliance standards.

controls.name: privacy and protection of personally identifiable information
controls.description: Privacy and protection of personally identifiable information shall be ensured as required in relevant legislation and regulation where applicable.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a privacy impact assessment to identify risks associated with the handling of personally identifiable information (PII).

controls.name: regulation of cryptographic controls

controls.name: independent review of information security
controls.description: The organizationΓÇÖs approach to managing information security and its implementation (i.e. control objectives, controls, policies, processes and procedures for information security) shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

Select qualified external auditors or independent reviewers with expertise in information security to conduct the reviews.
Prepare documentation detailing the current information security policies, controls, and processes to provide to the reviewers.

Analyze the findings from the independent review and develop an action plan to address any identified gaps or weaknesses in the information security management system.

controls.name: compliance with security policies and standards
controls.description: Managers shall regularly review the compliance of information processing and procedures within their area of responsibility with the appropriate security policies, standards and any other security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assign responsibility to managers for the regular review of compliance with security policies and standards within their respective areas.
Develop a checklist or framework that outlines the specific security policies and standards that need to be reviewed for compliance.
Schedule regular compliance review meetings to discuss findings and ensure accountability among managers.

Engage relevant technical teams to address any compliance issues identified during the review, ensuring timely remediation.
Maintain records of compliance reviews and actions taken to demonstrate adherence to information security policies and standards.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

Document the segregation of duties in the organization's policies and procedures.
Train personnel on the importance of segregation of duties and how it applies to their roles.
Regularly audit and review the segregation of duties to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information security policy that outlines the expectations for all personnel regarding security practices.

Implement a monitoring system to ensure compliance with the established policies and procedures.
Review and update the policies regularly to reflect changes in the organization or the threat landscape.

controls.name: management responsibilities

Designate specific personnel responsible for maintaining these contacts and ensure they are trained in communication protocols.

Train personnel on the importance of asset management and their responsibilities regarding the inventory.

controls.name: inventory of information and other associated assets

deployment_points.name: Develop clear rules and guidelines for the acceptable use of information and associated assets, tailored to the organization's needs.

Implement training programs to educate personnel on acceptable use policies and the consequences of violations.

controls.name: managing information security in the information and communication technology (ict) supply chain
controls.description: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for regular monitoring of supplier information security practices to ensure compliance with organizational standards.
Create a review process that includes evaluating supplier performance and security practices at defined intervals.
Implement a change management process that requires suppliers to notify the organization of any changes in their security practices or service delivery.
Develop a reporting mechanism to document findings from evaluations and reviews, ensuring transparency and accountability.
Train relevant staff on how to assess supplier security practices and manage changes effectively.

controls.name: monitoring, review and change management of supplier services
controls.description: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Define clear criteria for the acquisition of cloud services that align with the organizationΓÇÖs information security requirements.
Establish a management process for ongoing evaluation of cloud service providers to ensure compliance with security standards.
Create exit strategies for cloud services that include data migration and secure termination of services.
Document all processes related to the use and management of cloud services to ensure consistency and compliance.
Train staff on the established processes for managing cloud services, including acquisition, monitoring, and exit.

controls.name: information security for use of cloud services
controls.description: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating information security incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive incident management plan that outlines procedures for identifying and responding to information security incidents.
Assign specific roles and responsibilities to team members for managing incidents, ensuring clarity in the response process.
Communicate the incident management processes to all relevant stakeholders to ensure awareness and preparedness.
Conduct regular training sessions and simulations to test the incident management plan and improve response capabilities.
Review and update the incident management plan periodically to incorporate lessons learned and changes in the threat landscape.

controls.name: information security incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Establish criteria for assessing information security events to determine their severity and potential impact.
Create a standardized process for categorizing events as incidents based on the established criteria.
Train staff on how to recognize and report information security events accurately and promptly.
Implement a tracking system to log assessed events and their categorization for future reference and analysis.
Review the categorization process regularly to ensure it remains effective and aligned with evolving security threats.

controls.name: assessment and decision on information security events
controls.description: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.

deployment_points.name: Ensure that documented procedures for responding to information security incidents are readily accessible to all relevant personnel.
Train staff on the specific response procedures to ensure they understand their roles during an incident.
Conduct regular drills to practice incident response procedures and identify areas for improvement.
Establish a communication plan to inform stakeholders of incidents and response actions taken.
Review and update response procedures after each incident to incorporate lessons learned and improve future responses.

controls.name: response to information security incidents
controls.description: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.

deployment_points.name: Create a process for documenting lessons learned from each information security incident to inform future practices.
Analyze incidents to identify root causes and areas for improvement in existing security controls.
Share findings with relevant stakeholders to promote awareness and enhance overall security posture.
Update security policies and controls based on insights gained from incident analysis.
Conduct regular reviews of incident reports to ensure continuous improvement in security practices.

controls.name: learning from information security incidents
controls.description: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear procedures for identifying and collecting evidence related to information security events, ensuring compliance with legal standards.
Train staff on proper evidence collection techniques to maintain the integrity of the evidence.
Implement a chain of custody process to track evidence from collection to preservation.
Ensure that evidence is stored securely and is accessible only to authorized personnel.
Regularly review and update evidence collection procedures to align with best practices and legal requirements.

controls.name: collection of evidence
controls.description: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

deployment_points.name: Develop a business continuity plan that includes strategies for maintaining information security during disruptions.
Identify critical assets and processes that require protection during a disruption and prioritize them in the planning process.
Train staff on their roles and responsibilities in maintaining security during disruptions.
Conduct regular testing of the business continuity plan to ensure its effectiveness in real-world scenarios.
Review and update the plan regularly to incorporate changes in the organization and its environment.

controls.name: information security during disruption
controls.description: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish ICT continuity requirements based on business continuity objectives to ensure alignment with organizational goals.
Develop a plan for implementing ICT readiness measures, including infrastructure, personnel, and processes.
Conduct regular testing of ICT systems to ensure they can support business continuity during disruptions.
Maintain documentation of ICT readiness measures and their effectiveness for future reference.
Review and update ICT readiness plans regularly to adapt to changes in technology and business needs.

controls.name: ict readiness for business continuity
controls.description: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organizationΓÇÖs approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive review of all legal, statutory, regulatory, and contractual requirements related to information security applicable to the organization.
Document identified requirements clearly, ensuring they are easily accessible to relevant stakeholders.
Establish a process for regularly reviewing and updating the documentation to reflect changes in laws and regulations.
Train staff on the importance of compliance with these requirements and their roles in maintaining it.
Implement a monitoring system to ensure ongoing compliance with identified requirements.

controls.name: legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements
controls.description: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.

deployment_points.name: Identify all intellectual property assets within the organization and classify them based on their sensitivity and importance.
Develop and document procedures that outline how to protect these assets, including access controls and usage guidelines.
Train employees on the importance of intellectual property rights and the specific procedures in place to protect them.
Regularly review and update the procedures to ensure they remain effective and compliant with legal requirements.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to detect and respond to any unauthorized access or breaches of intellectual property.

controls.name: intellectual property rights
controls.description: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.

deployment_points.name: Establish a comprehensive records management policy that defines how records are created, stored, and disposed of securely.
Implement access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can access sensitive records.
Utilize encryption and other security measures to protect records from unauthorized access and potential breaches.
Conduct regular audits of records to ensure compliance with protection measures and identify any vulnerabilities.
Provide training to employees on the importance of record protection and the specific measures in place to safeguard them.

controls.name: protection of records
controls.description: The organization shall identify and meet the requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII according to applicable laws and regulations and contractual requirements.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a thorough assessment to identify all personally identifiable information (PII) held by the organization and its regulatory requirements.
Develop and implement policies and procedures that outline how PII will be collected, stored, processed, and disposed of securely.
Ensure that all employees handling PII receive training on privacy laws and the organization's specific requirements for PII protection.
Regularly review and update PII protection measures to ensure compliance with changing laws and regulations.
Implement monitoring and reporting mechanisms to detect and respond to any breaches or unauthorized access to PII.

controls.name: privacy and protection of personal identifiable information (pii)
controls.description: The organizationΓÇÖs approach to managing information security and its implementation including people, processes and technologies shall be reviewed independently at planned intervals, or when significant changes occur.

deployment_points.name: Establish a schedule for independent reviews of the organization's information security management approach, including people, processes, and technologies.
Define the scope and criteria for the independent review to ensure comprehensive coverage of all relevant areas.
Engage qualified external auditors or consultants to conduct the reviews and provide objective assessments.
Document the findings of the reviews and develop action plans to address any identified weaknesses or areas for improvement.
Communicate the results of the reviews to relevant stakeholders and ensure that corrective actions are implemented in a timely manner.

controls.name: independent review of information security
controls.description: Compliance with the organizationΓÇÖs information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Develop a compliance review schedule that outlines how often the information security policies and standards will be reviewed.
Assign responsibility for conducting compliance reviews to a designated team or individual within the organization.
Create a checklist based on the organization's policies and standards to guide the compliance review process.
Document the results of the compliance reviews and identify any non-compliance issues that need to be addressed.
Ensure that corrective actions are taken for any identified non-compliance and that the results are communicated to relevant stakeholders.

controls.name: compliance with policies, rules and standards for information security
controls.description: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.

deployment_points.name: Identify all critical operating procedures related to information processing facilities and document them in a clear and concise manner.
Ensure that the documented procedures are easily accessible to all personnel who require them for their job functions.
Provide training to personnel on the documented procedures to ensure they understand their roles and responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the operating procedures to reflect any changes in technology or organizational processes.
Implement a version control system to track changes to the documented procedures and ensure that personnel are using the most current versions.

controls.name: documented operating procedures
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis taking into consideration applicable laws, regulations and ethics and be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

deployment_points.name: Develop a background verification policy that outlines the types of checks to be conducted based on the role and access level of the candidate.
Implement a standardized process for conducting background checks, including criminal history, employment verification, and reference checks.
Ensure that all background checks are conducted in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including data protection laws.
Document the results of background checks and maintain records in a secure manner to protect candidate privacy.
Review and update the background verification policy regularly to ensure it remains effective and aligned with business needs.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: The employment contractual agreements shall state the personnelΓÇÖs and the organizationΓÇÖs responsibilities for information security.

deployment_points.name: Draft employment contracts that clearly outline the information security responsibilities of both the organization and the personnel.
Include clauses in the contracts that address confidentiality, data protection, and compliance with information security policies.
Ensure that all new hires receive and sign the updated employment contracts before starting their roles.
Regularly review and update the contractual agreements to reflect any changes in information security policies or regulations.
Provide training to personnel on their responsibilities as outlined in the employment contracts to ensure understanding and compliance.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: Personnel of the organization and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information security awareness and training program tailored to different job functions within the organization.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to ensure all personnel are informed about the latest information security policies and procedures.
Utilize various training methods, such as workshops, e-learning, and simulations, to engage personnel effectively.
Track attendance and completion of training to ensure compliance and identify any gaps in knowledge.
Solicit feedback from personnel on the training program to continuously improve its effectiveness and relevance.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel and other relevant interested parties who have committed an information security policy violation.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal disciplinary policy that outlines the consequences of violating information security policies and procedures.
Communicate the disciplinary policy to all personnel and ensure they understand the potential repercussions of violations.
Establish a process for reporting and investigating information security policy violations in a fair and consistent manner.
Document all disciplinary actions taken and maintain records to ensure accountability and transparency.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary policy to ensure it remains effective and aligned with organizational values.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated to relevant personnel and other interested parties.

deployment_points.name: Define clear information security responsibilities for all personnel, including those who have left the organization or changed roles.
Develop a formal disciplinary process that outlines consequences for breaches of information security responsibilities.
Communicate the disciplinary process to all employees during onboarding and through regular training sessions.
Ensure that the disciplinary process is documented and accessible to all relevant personnel.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary process to reflect changes in organizational policies or legal requirements.

controls.name: responsibilities after termination or change of employment
controls.description: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organizationΓÇÖs needs for the protection of information shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and other relevant interested parties.

deployment_points.name: Identify all personnel who require confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements based on their roles and access to sensitive information.
Draft clear and comprehensive confidentiality agreements that outline the obligations of personnel regarding information protection.
Ensure that all identified personnel sign the agreements before they gain access to sensitive information.
Establish a schedule for regular reviews of the agreements to ensure they remain relevant and effective.
Maintain a secure repository for all signed agreements and track compliance with the terms outlined.

controls.name: confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organizationΓÇÖs premises.

deployment_points.name: Develop a remote work policy that outlines security measures for accessing, processing, and storing information remotely.
Provide secure access methods, such as VPNs, for personnel to connect to the organization's network when working remotely.
Implement endpoint security solutions on devices used for remote work to protect against malware and unauthorized access.
Conduct training sessions for personnel on best practices for information security while working remotely.
Regularly review and update remote work security measures to address emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

controls.name: remote working
controls.description: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear reporting channels for personnel to report information security events, such as a dedicated email or hotline.
Create a user-friendly reporting form that guides personnel on how to provide necessary details about the event.
Train all personnel on the importance of reporting security events and how to use the reporting mechanism effectively.
Ensure that reports are handled confidentially and that there are no repercussions for reporting in good faith.
Regularly review and analyze reported events to improve the organization's security posture and response procedures.
Develop a formalized process for reporting information security events, including clear guidelines on what constitutes an event.
Implement a centralized reporting system that allows personnel to submit reports easily and track their status.
Train personnel on the importance of timely reporting and the steps to take when they observe a security event.
Establish a response team responsible for investigating reported events and taking appropriate action.
Regularly review the reporting process and update it based on feedback and lessons learned from past events.

controls.name: physical security parameters
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.

deployment_points.name: Identify and map out all areas that contain sensitive information and associated assets within the organization.
Define physical security perimeters around these areas using barriers, signage, and access controls.
Implement access control measures, such as key cards or biometric systems, to restrict entry to authorized personnel only.
Regularly review and assess the effectiveness of the defined security perimeters and make adjustments as necessary.
Train personnel on the importance of maintaining security perimeters and the procedures for reporting breaches.

controls.name: physical entry access points
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls.

deployment_points.name: Identify all entry points to secure areas and assess the level of access control required for each.
Install appropriate entry control systems, such as electronic locks, security guards, or visitor management systems.
Ensure that access to secure areas is limited to authorized personnel only, with a clear process for granting and revoking access.
Regularly test and maintain entry control systems to ensure they are functioning correctly and securely.
Train personnel on access control policies and procedures, including how to report any security concerns.

controls.name: securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in the physical security of offices, rooms, and facilities.
Design a physical security plan that includes measures such as locks, alarms, and surveillance systems.
Implement the physical security measures as per the designed plan, ensuring compliance with relevant regulations.
Regularly review and update the physical security measures to address new threats or changes in the environment.
Train personnel on the physical security measures in place and their roles in maintaining a secure environment.

controls.name: physical security monitoring
controls.description: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.

deployment_points.name: Install surveillance cameras and monitoring systems at key access points and throughout the premises.
Establish a monitoring protocol that includes regular reviews of surveillance footage and incident reporting.
Assign personnel to monitor security feeds in real-time and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.
Regularly test and maintain monitoring equipment to ensure it is operational and effective.
Train personnel on the monitoring procedures and the importance of reporting suspicious activities.

controls.name: protecting against physical and environmental threats
controls.description: Protection against physical and environmental threats, such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional physical threats to infrastructure shall be designed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential physical and environmental threats to the organization's infrastructure.
Develop a comprehensive protection plan that includes measures such as fire suppression systems, flood barriers, and emergency exits.
Implement the protection measures as per the developed plan, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.
Regularly review and update the protection plan to address new threats or changes in the environment.
Train personnel on the protection measures in place and their roles in responding to physical and environmental threats.

controls.name: working in secure areas
controls.description: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Identify and designate secure areas within the organization where sensitive information is processed or stored.
Implement access controls such as key cards or biometric systems to restrict entry to authorized personnel only.
Establish and communicate policies regarding the behavior and activities permitted within secure areas to all employees.
Conduct regular security audits and assessments of secure areas to ensure compliance with established security measures.
Provide training for employees on the importance of security in these areas and the specific protocols they must follow.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen
controls.description: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear desk policy that mandates the removal of sensitive documents and removable media from desks at the end of each workday.
Implement screen lock policies that require users to lock their computers when leaving their desks unattended.
Communicate the clear desk and screen policies to all employees and provide training on their importance.
Conduct regular inspections to ensure compliance with the clear desk and screen policies across the organization.
Establish consequences for non-compliance to reinforce the importance of maintaining a secure work environment.

controls.name: equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.

deployment_points.name: Assess the physical location of all equipment to ensure it is situated in secure areas with limited access.
Use physical barriers such as locked cabinets or cages to protect sensitive equipment from unauthorized access.
Implement environmental controls such as fire suppression systems and climate control to protect equipment from damage.
Regularly review and update the siting and protection measures based on changes in equipment or security requirements.
Train staff on the importance of equipment protection and the specific measures in place to safeguard it.

controls.name: security of assets off-premises
controls.description: Off-site assets shall be protected.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for the secure transport of off-site assets, including guidelines for packaging and handling.
Ensure that all off-site assets are tracked and logged to maintain accountability and visibility.
Implement encryption and password protection for sensitive data stored on portable devices taken off-premises.
