Provide training to employees on the risks associated with off-site assets and the measures they must take to protect them.
Conduct regular audits of off-site assets to ensure compliance with security policies and identify any potential vulnerabilities.

controls.name: storage media
controls.description: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs classification scheme and handling requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish a lifecycle management policy for storage media that includes acquisition, usage, transportation, and disposal procedures.
Classify storage media based on the sensitivity of the information they contain and apply appropriate handling requirements.
Implement secure storage solutions for sensitive media, including locked cabinets or secure digital storage options.
Train employees on the proper handling and disposal methods for storage media to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive information.
Regularly review and update the storage media management policy to ensure it aligns with current best practices and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: supporting utilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

deployment_points.name: Install uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) to provide backup power during outages and protect against power surges.
Conduct regular maintenance and testing of all supporting utilities to ensure they are functioning correctly and reliably.
Develop contingency plans for utility failures, including procedures for data backup and recovery.
Train staff on the importance of supporting utilities and the procedures to follow in case of a failure.
Regularly review and update the utility protection measures based on technological advancements and organizational needs.

controls.name: cabling security
controls.description: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

deployment_points.name: Route cables through secure pathways, such as conduits or cable trays, to minimize exposure to unauthorized access.
Use cable locks or other physical security measures to secure critical cables in place and prevent tampering.
Regularly inspect cables for signs of wear, damage, or unauthorized access and address any issues promptly.
Implement labeling and documentation practices for all cabling to maintain an inventory and facilitate troubleshooting.
Train staff on the importance of cabling security and the specific measures in place to protect these assets.

controls.name: equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.

deployment_points.name: Develop a maintenance schedule for all equipment that includes regular inspections and servicing.
Document all maintenance activities, including repairs and upgrades, to maintain a history of equipment status.
Train staff on the importance of proper equipment maintenance and the procedures to follow for reporting issues.
Implement a monitoring system to track equipment performance and identify potential issues before they lead to failures.
Regularly review and update maintenance procedures to ensure they align with best practices and technological advancements.

controls.name: secure disposal or re-use of equipment
controls.description: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a secure disposal policy that outlines the procedures for handling equipment containing sensitive data.
Use data wiping software or physical destruction methods to ensure that all sensitive information is irretrievable before disposal.
Maintain records of all disposed or reused equipment, including the methods used for data destruction.
Train employees on the secure disposal procedures and the importance of protecting sensitive information.
Regularly review and update the disposal policy to ensure compliance with current regulations and best practices.

controls.name: user end point devices
controls.description: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user end point devices shall be protected.

deployment_points.name: Implement endpoint security solutions, such as antivirus software and firewalls, on all user devices to protect against threats.
Enforce strong password policies and multi-factor authentication for accessing devices and sensitive information.
Regularly update and patch operating systems and applications on user devices to mitigate vulnerabilities.
Train users on safe computing practices, including recognizing phishing attempts and securing their devices.
Conduct regular audits of endpoint devices to ensure compliance with security policies and identify potential risks.

controls.name: privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.

deployment_points.name: Identify all roles that require privileged access and document their responsibilities.
Implement a formal approval process for granting privileged access, ensuring it is limited to necessary personnel only.
Regularly review and audit privileged access rights to ensure compliance with the established policies.
Utilize multi-factor authentication for all accounts with privileged access to enhance security.
Provide training for users with privileged access on security best practices and the importance of access management.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a topic-specific access control policy that outlines access levels and restrictions.
Implement role-based access control (RBAC) to ensure users only have access to information necessary for their roles.
Regularly review access permissions to ensure they align with current job functions and responsibilities.
Use logging and monitoring tools to track access to sensitive information and detect unauthorized attempts.
Conduct training sessions for employees on the importance of information access restrictions and compliance with policies.

controls.name: access to source code
controls.description: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.

deployment_points.name: Establish a version control system to manage access to source code and track changes.
Define user roles and permissions for accessing source code, ensuring only authorized personnel can make changes.
Implement code review processes to ensure that changes to the source code are vetted by qualified individuals.
Regularly audit access logs to monitor who accessed the source code and what changes were made.
Provide training for developers on secure coding practices and the importance of source code management.

controls.name: secure authentication
controls.description: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.

deployment_points.name: Implement strong password policies that require complex passwords and regular updates.
Utilize multi-factor authentication (MFA) for all systems that handle sensitive information.
Regularly review and update authentication methods to incorporate the latest security technologies.
Train users on secure authentication practices and the importance of safeguarding their credentials.
Monitor authentication logs for unusual access patterns and respond to potential security incidents.

controls.name: capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools to track resource usage across all systems and applications.
Establish baseline metrics for resource usage to identify trends and predict future capacity needs.
Regularly review capacity reports and adjust resources accordingly to prevent bottlenecks.
Develop a capacity planning process that includes forecasting and resource allocation strategies.
Train IT staff on capacity management best practices and the importance of proactive resource management.

controls.name: protection against malware
controls.description: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

deployment_points.name: Install and maintain up-to-date antivirus and anti-malware software on all systems.
Conduct regular scans of systems and networks to detect and remove malware threats.
Provide user training on recognizing phishing attempts and safe browsing practices to reduce malware risks.
Implement a policy for reporting suspected malware incidents and ensure timely responses.
Regularly review and update malware protection measures based on emerging threats and vulnerabilities.

controls.name: management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organizationΓÇÖs exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for regularly scanning systems for known vulnerabilities using automated tools.
Maintain an inventory of all software and hardware assets to assess their vulnerability status.
Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk assessment and implement remediation plans accordingly.
Stay informed about the latest security advisories and patches from vendors and apply them promptly.
Conduct regular training for IT staff on vulnerability management practices and the importance of timely updates.

controls.name: configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Develop a configuration management policy that outlines standards for all hardware and software configurations.
Use configuration management tools to automate the documentation and monitoring of configurations.
Regularly review and audit configurations to ensure compliance with established standards and policies.
Implement change management processes to control modifications to configurations and minimize risks.
Train staff on configuration management best practices and the importance of maintaining secure configurations.

controls.name: information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

deployment_points.name: Establish a data retention policy that defines how long different types of information should be kept.
Implement automated tools to securely delete information that is no longer required based on the retention policy.
Regularly review stored information to identify and delete data that is past its retention period.
Ensure that deletion processes comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements for data disposal.
Train employees on the importance of data deletion and the procedures for securely removing information.

controls.name: data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

deployment_points.name: Develop a data masking policy that outlines when and how data masking should be applied.
Implement data masking techniques in systems that handle sensitive information to protect data privacy.
Regularly review and update data masking methods to ensure they meet current business and legal requirements.
Train staff on the importance of data masking and how to apply it effectively in their workflows.
Monitor the effectiveness of data masking solutions and adjust as necessary to address new risks.

controls.name: data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive information across all systems and networks to determine where data leakage prevention measures are necessary.
Implement data loss prevention (DLP) tools that monitor and control data transfers, ensuring sensitive data is not sent outside the organization without authorization.
Establish policies and procedures for handling sensitive information, including encryption and access controls to prevent unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update DLP measures to adapt to new threats and changes in the data landscape.
Train employees on data leakage prevention practices and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up information and systems.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of critical data and systems.
Store backup copies in secure, offsite locations to protect against data loss due to physical disasters.
Regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure data can be recovered quickly and accurately when needed.
Document and review backup procedures periodically to ensure compliance with the backup policy and address any identified gaps.

controls.name: redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the availability requirements of critical information processing facilities to determine necessary redundancy levels.
Implement redundant systems, such as failover servers and load balancers, to ensure continuous operation during failures.
Regularly test redundancy mechanisms to verify that they function correctly and can handle failover scenarios.
Monitor the performance of redundant systems to ensure they are operating effectively and efficiently.
Document redundancy strategies and update them as necessary to reflect changes in technology or business needs.

controls.name: logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

deployment_points.name: Establish logging policies that define what events should be logged, including user activities, system errors, and security incidents.
Implement logging mechanisms across all systems and applications to capture relevant data in real-time.
Store logs securely to prevent unauthorized access and ensure their integrity for future analysis.
Regularly review and analyze logs to identify anomalies or security incidents that require further investigation.
Retain logs for a defined period in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.

controls.name: monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools that provide real-time visibility into network traffic, system performance, and application behavior.
Define baseline behavior for systems and networks to identify deviations that may indicate security incidents.
Establish incident response procedures to follow when anomalous behavior is detected, including escalation protocols.
Regularly review monitoring configurations and thresholds to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.
Train staff on monitoring tools and incident response processes to ensure timely and effective action when anomalies are detected.

controls.name: clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

deployment_points.name: Identify and configure approved time sources, such as NTP servers, for synchronizing clocks across all information processing systems.
Implement automated synchronization processes to ensure that all systems maintain accurate time settings.
Regularly verify the accuracy of system clocks and the functionality of synchronization mechanisms.
Document the time synchronization process and any deviations from the standard to maintain compliance.
Educate staff on the importance of time synchronization for security logging and incident response.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs in use within the organization and assess their necessity for operational tasks.
Implement strict access controls to limit the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Monitor and log the usage of privileged utility programs to detect any unauthorized or suspicious activities.
Regularly review and update the list of approved utility programs to ensure compliance with security policies.
Provide training to users on the risks associated with privileged utility programs and the importance of adhering to access controls.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal software installation policy that outlines the approval process and security requirements for new software.
Implement a change management process to review and approve software installations before they are executed.
Use automated tools to manage software installations and ensure that only approved software is deployed on operational systems.
Regularly audit installed software to identify unauthorized or outdated applications that may pose security risks.
Train staff on the software installation policy and the importance of maintaining a secure operational environment.

controls.name: network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in the network and prioritize security measures accordingly.
Implement firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other security technologies to protect network perimeters and internal segments.
Regularly update and patch network devices to protect against known vulnerabilities and exploits.
Monitor network traffic for suspicious activities and respond promptly to potential security incidents.
Document network security policies and procedures, ensuring they are communicated to all relevant personnel.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Identify all network services in use and assess their security requirements based on organizational policies and compliance needs.
Implement security mechanisms such as encryption, authentication, and access controls for all network services.
Define service level agreements (SLAs) that outline security expectations and performance metrics for network services.
Regularly monitor network services for compliance with security policies and SLAs, addressing any deviations promptly.
Provide training to staff on the security requirements of network services and the importance of adhering to established protocols.

controls.name: segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organizationΓÇÖs networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize all information services, users, and information systems within the organization.
Design network architecture to create distinct segments for different groups based on their security requirements.
Implement firewalls and access control lists to enforce segregation between network segments.
Regularly review and update network segmentation policies to adapt to changes in the organization.
Monitor network traffic between segments to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

deployment_points.name: Select and deploy a web filtering solution that aligns with organizational security policies.
Configure the filtering solution to block access to known malicious websites and categories deemed inappropriate.
Regularly update the filtering rules and threat intelligence feeds to ensure effectiveness against new threats.
Educate users on the importance of web filtering and safe browsing practices.
Monitor and log web access attempts to identify potential security incidents and adjust filtering policies accordingly.

controls.name: use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Establish a cryptographic policy that defines the types of data requiring encryption and the cryptographic methods to be used.
Implement key management practices that include key generation, distribution, storage, and destruction.
Train personnel on the importance of cryptography and the proper handling of cryptographic keys.
Regularly review and update cryptographic algorithms and key lengths to comply with industry standards.
Monitor the use of cryptographic systems to detect and respond to any anomalies or breaches.

controls.name: secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

deployment_points.name: Define a secure development life cycle (SDLC) framework that integrates security at each phase of development.
Train development teams on secure coding practices and the importance of security in software development.
Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments during the design phase to identify potential vulnerabilities.
Implement security testing procedures, including static and dynamic analysis, throughout the development process.
Review and update the SDLC regularly to incorporate lessons learned and emerging security threats.

controls.name: application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting security requirements for all new applications.
Involve stakeholders from security, development, and business units in the requirements gathering process.
Review and approve security requirements before development or acquisition begins to ensure alignment with organizational policies.
Conduct regular audits of applications to ensure compliance with defined security requirements.
Update security requirements as necessary to address new threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: secure system architecture principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document secure system architecture principles that align with organizational security goals.
Ensure that all system development activities adhere to these principles from the initial design phase through deployment.
Conduct regular training sessions for architects and developers on secure architecture practices.
Review and update architecture principles periodically to reflect changes in technology and threat landscape.
Implement a review process to assess compliance with secure architecture principles during system development.

controls.name: secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

deployment_points.name: Define and document secure coding standards that all developers must follow during software development.
Provide training for developers on secure coding practices and common vulnerabilities.
Implement code review processes to ensure adherence to secure coding standards before code is merged.
Utilize automated tools to scan for security vulnerabilities in the codebase during development.
Regularly update secure coding standards to address new vulnerabilities and best practices.

controls.name: security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Establish a security testing strategy that outlines testing methods and tools to be used throughout the development life cycle.
Integrate security testing into the continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure ongoing assessment.
Train development and testing teams on security testing methodologies and tools.
Document and track security testing results, including vulnerabilities found and remediation efforts.
Review and refine security testing processes regularly to improve effectiveness and adapt to new threats.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear guidelines and expectations for security and quality in outsourced development contracts.
Monitor the progress of outsourced development projects through regular status meetings and reporting.
Conduct security assessments of the outsourced development processes and deliverables.
Ensure that outsourced developers are trained on the organizationΓÇÖs security policies and practices.
Review and evaluate the performance of outsourced development partners regularly to ensure compliance with security requirements.

controls.name: development, testing and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

deployment_points.name: Create distinct environments for development, testing, and production to prevent unauthorized access and changes.
Implement access controls to restrict personnel access to each environment based on their role and necessity.
Regularly audit and monitor the environments to ensure compliance with security policies and detect any unauthorized changes.
Establish procedures for promoting code from development to testing and production that include security checks.
Document and maintain the configurations of each environment to ensure consistency and security.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management policy that outlines the procedures for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes to information systems.
Implement a change request system where all proposed changes are documented, including the rationale, impact analysis, and approval status.
Ensure that all changes are tested in a controlled environment before deployment to minimize risks to operational systems.
Conduct regular reviews of change management processes to ensure compliance with the policy and to identify areas for improvement.
Train relevant personnel on change management procedures to ensure consistent application and understanding across the organization.

controls.name: test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

deployment_points.name: Define criteria for selecting test information to ensure it is relevant and representative of production data while minimizing exposure of sensitive information.
Implement access controls to restrict who can view and use test information, ensuring that only authorized personnel have access.
Establish procedures for the secure storage and transmission of test information to protect it from unauthorized access or breaches.
Regularly review and update test information management practices to align with data protection regulations and organizational policies.
Provide training for staff on the importance of protecting test information and the specific procedures in place to manage it securely.

controls.name: protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal audit testing plan that outlines the scope, objectives, and methodologies to be used during the assessment of operational systems.
Schedule meetings between auditors and management to discuss and agree on the audit plan, ensuring alignment on expectations and resource availability.
Implement safeguards to protect operational systems during testing, including limiting access to sensitive areas and ensuring data integrity.
Document all findings and recommendations from the audit testing process, and ensure they are communicated to relevant stakeholders for action.
Conduct follow-up reviews to ensure that management has addressed any issues identified during the audit testing and to assess the effectiveness of implemented changes.

controls.name: control of outsourced processes
controls.description: Where an organization chooses to outsource any process that affects product conformity with requirements, the organization shall ensure control over such processes. Control of such outsourced processes shall be identified within the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Identify all processes that are outsourced and assess their impact on product conformity.
Establish criteria for selecting and evaluating outsourcing partners to ensure they meet quality standards.
Document the control measures for each outsourced process within the quality management system.
Monitor and review the performance of outsourced processes regularly to ensure compliance with quality requirements.
Implement corrective actions for any non-conformities identified in outsourced processes.

controls.name: general
controls.description: The quality management system documentation shall include documented statements of a quality policy and quality objectives, a quality manual, documented procedures required by this International Standard, documents needed by the organization to ensure the effective planning, operation and control of its processes, and records required by this International Standard.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive quality policy that aligns with organizational goals and objectives.
Create a quality manual that outlines the scope and structure of the quality management system.
Document all necessary procedures and ensure they are accessible to relevant personnel.
Establish a system for regularly reviewing and updating documentation to reflect current practices.
Ensure that all records are maintained in a manner that supports traceability and compliance.

controls.name: quality manual
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain a quality manual that includes the scope of the quality management system, including details of and justification for any exclusions, the documented procedures established for the quality management system, or reference to them, and a description of the interaction between the processes of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Draft a quality manual that clearly defines the scope of the quality management system.
Include justifications for any exclusions from the quality management system in the manual.
Reference all documented procedures within the quality manual for easy access.
Describe the interactions between different processes in the quality management system to ensure clarity.
Review and update the quality manual regularly to ensure it remains relevant and accurate.

controls.name: control of documents
controls.description: Documents required by the quality management system shall be controlled. A documented procedure shall be established to define the controls needed to approve documents for adequacy prior to issue, to review and update as necessary and re-approve documents, to ensure that changes and the current revision status of documents are identified, to ensure that relevant versions of applicable documents are available at points of use, to ensure that documents remain legible and identifiable, to ensure that documents of external origin are identified and their distribution controlled, and to prevent the unintended use of obsolete documents.

deployment_points.name: Establish a documented procedure for the approval and review of all quality management system documents.
Implement a version control system to track changes and current revision status of documents.
Ensure that all relevant documents are accessible at points of use for personnel.
Train staff on the importance of document control and the procedures in place to maintain it.
Regularly audit document control processes to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

controls.name: control of records
controls.description: Records shall be established and maintained to provide evidence of conformity to requirements and of the effective operation of the quality management system. Records shall remain legible, readily identifiable and retrievable. A documented procedure shall be established to define the controls needed for the identification, storage, protection, retrieval, retention time and disposition of records.

deployment_points.name: Develop a documented procedure for the management of records, including identification and storage methods.
Ensure that all records are legible, identifiable, and easily retrievable by authorized personnel.
Define retention times for different types of records based on regulatory and organizational requirements.
Implement protective measures to safeguard records from loss or damage.
Regularly review and update the records management procedure to ensure it meets current needs.

controls.name: management commitment
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to the quality management system by ensuring that the quality policy and objectives are established and are compatible with the strategic direction and the context of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Top management should actively participate in the development of the quality policy and objectives.
Ensure that the quality policy aligns with the strategic direction of the organization.
Communicate the importance of the quality management system to all employees.
Allocate necessary resources to support the implementation and maintenance of the quality management system.
Regularly review the quality policy and objectives to ensure ongoing relevance and effectiveness.

controls.name: customer focus
controls.description: Top management shall demonstrate leadership and commitment with respect to customer focus by ensuring that customer requirements are determined and are met with the aim of enhancing customer satisfaction.

deployment_points.name: Establish processes to gather and analyze customer requirements and feedback.
Ensure that customer requirements are integrated into the planning and operational processes.
Communicate customer satisfaction goals to all levels of the organization.
Monitor customer satisfaction metrics and take corrective actions as needed.
Regularly review customer focus initiatives to ensure they are effective and aligned with organizational goals.

controls.name: quality policy
controls.description: Top management shall establish, implement and maintain a quality policy that: a) is appropriate to the purpose and context of the organization; b) provides a framework for setting quality objectives; c) includes a commitment to satisfy applicable requirements; and d) includes a commitment to continual improvement of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Develop a quality policy that reflects the organizationΓÇÖs purpose and context.
Ensure the quality policy provides a clear framework for setting measurable quality objectives.
Communicate the quality policy to all employees and stakeholders.
Review the quality policy regularly to ensure it remains relevant and effective.
Promote a culture of continual improvement in alignment with the quality policy.

controls.name: planning
controls.description: Top management shall ensure that: a) the planning of the quality management system is aligned with the strategic direction of the organization; b) quality objectives are established at relevant functions and levels; and c) the planning of the quality management system is carried out in such a way that it is integrated into the organizationΓÇÖs business processes.

deployment_points.name: Align the planning of the quality management system with the organizationΓÇÖs strategic goals and objectives.
Set specific, measurable quality objectives at all relevant levels of the organization.
Integrate quality management planning into existing business processes to ensure coherence.
Communicate the planning outcomes to all relevant stakeholders.
Regularly review and adjust the planning process to respond to changes in the organization or market.

controls.name: management representative
controls.description: Top management shall ensure that responsibilities and authorities are defined and communicated within the organization.

deployment_points.name: Clearly define roles and responsibilities related to the quality management system within the organization.
Communicate these responsibilities and authorities to all employees to ensure understanding.
Establish a framework for accountability and reporting on quality management activities.
Provide training to employees on their specific responsibilities within the quality management system.
Regularly review and update the defined responsibilities to reflect any organizational changes.

controls.description: The organization shall conduct management reviews at planned intervals to ensure the quality management system is still adequate, effective and aligned with the strategic direction of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Schedule management review meetings at regular intervals, such as quarterly or bi-annually, to assess the quality management system.
Prepare an agenda for each meeting that includes key performance indicators, audit results, and feedback from stakeholders.
Document the findings and decisions made during the review meetings to ensure accountability and follow-up actions.
Assign responsibilities for action items identified during the reviews to relevant team members to ensure timely implementation.
Communicate the outcomes of the management reviews to all relevant stakeholders to promote transparency and continuous improvement.

controls.name: provision of resources
controls.description: The organization shall determine and provide the resources needed for the establishment, implementation, maintenance and continual improvement of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a resource assessment to identify the necessary human, technological, and financial resources required for the quality management system.
Allocate budget and resources based on the assessment to ensure all aspects of the quality management system are adequately supported.
Establish a process for monitoring resource utilization and effectiveness to ensure optimal use of resources.
Provide training and development opportunities to staff to enhance their skills and competencies related to the quality management system.
Review and adjust resource allocation periodically to align with changes in organizational goals and quality objectives.

controls.name: human resources
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that: a) the necessary competence is determined; b) the necessary competence is acquired; c) the effectiveness of the actions taken to acquire the necessary competence is evaluated; and d) the personnel are aware of the relevance and importance of their activities and how they contribute to the achievement of the quality objectives.

deployment_points.name: Identify the competencies required for each role within the quality management system and document them clearly.
Develop a training program to address any gaps in competencies and ensure personnel acquire the necessary skills.
Implement a performance evaluation system to assess the effectiveness of training and the competencies of personnel regularly.
Conduct awareness sessions to educate staff on the importance of their roles in achieving quality objectives and the overall impact on the organization.
Maintain records of training and competency assessments to track progress and compliance with quality management requirements.

controls.name: infrastructure
controls.description: The organization shall determine, provide and maintain the infrastructure needed to achieve conformity to product requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the current infrastructure to identify any deficiencies that may hinder the achievement of product conformity.
Develop a plan to upgrade or acquire necessary infrastructure, including facilities, equipment, and technology.
Implement maintenance schedules for all infrastructure components to ensure they remain in good working condition and meet product requirements.
Monitor the effectiveness of the infrastructure in supporting product conformity through regular reviews and audits.
Ensure that all personnel are trained on the proper use and maintenance of infrastructure to maximize its effectiveness.

controls.name: work environment
controls.description: The organization shall determine and manage the work environment needed to achieve conformity to product requirements.

deployment_points.name: Evaluate the current work environment to identify factors that may affect product quality, such as safety, ergonomics, and cleanliness.
Develop and implement policies and procedures to manage and improve the work environment based on the evaluation findings.
Provide necessary resources, such as safety equipment and ergonomic tools, to enhance the work environment for employees.
Conduct regular inspections and assessments of the work environment to ensure compliance with established standards and regulations.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging employee feedback on the work environment and implementing suggested changes.

controls.name: planning of product realization
controls.description: The organization shall plan and develop the processes needed for product realization.

deployment_points.name: Define the stages of the product realization process, including planning, design, production, and delivery.
Develop detailed process maps for each stage to outline responsibilities, inputs, outputs, and interactions.
Establish criteria for evaluating the effectiveness of each process stage to ensure alignment with quality objectives.
Implement a project management approach to monitor progress and make adjustments as necessary throughout the product realization process.
Document all processes and ensure that they are communicated to relevant stakeholders to promote understanding and compliance.

controls.name: customer-related processes
controls.description: The organization shall determine and review the requirements related to the product.

deployment_points.name: Engage with customers to gather and document their requirements and expectations regarding the product.
Analyze customer feedback and requirements to identify trends and areas for improvement in product offerings.
Establish a review process to regularly assess and update customer requirements to ensure they remain relevant.
Communicate customer requirements to all relevant departments to ensure alignment in product development and delivery.
Monitor customer satisfaction and product performance to evaluate the effectiveness of meeting customer requirements.

controls.name: design and development
controls.description: The organization shall establish, implement and maintain a design and development process that is appropriate to ensure the subsequent provision of products.

deployment_points.name: Define the design and development process, including stages such as concept, design, testing, and validation.
Assign roles and responsibilities for each stage of the design and development process to ensure accountability.
Implement a review and approval process at key milestones to ensure that the design meets specified requirements.
Document all design and development activities, including decisions made and changes implemented, for traceability.
Conduct post-launch evaluations to assess the effectiveness of the design and development process and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: purchasing
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that purchased product conforms to specified purchase requirements.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear purchasing specifications that outline the requirements for all products and services to be procured.
Develop a supplier evaluation and selection process to ensure that suppliers meet the specified requirements.
Implement a system for monitoring supplier performance and compliance with purchase requirements.
Conduct regular audits of suppliers to verify that they consistently provide conforming products.
Maintain records of purchasing decisions and supplier evaluations to ensure transparency and accountability.

controls.name: production and service provision
controls.description: The organization shall plan and carry out production and service provision under controlled conditions.

deployment_points.name: Develop a production plan that outlines the processes, resources, and timelines required for production and service provision.
Implement controls to monitor production processes, including quality checks and process validations, to ensure conformity.
Train personnel on the production and service provision processes to ensure they understand their roles and responsibilities.
Establish a system for documenting production activities and outcomes to facilitate traceability and accountability.
Conduct regular reviews of production processes to identify opportunities for improvement and ensure compliance with quality standards.

controls.name: control of monitoring and measuring devices
controls.description: The organization shall determine the monitoring and measuring to be undertaken and the monitoring and measuring devices needed to provide evidence of conformity of product to determined requirements.

deployment_points.name: Identify the specific monitoring and measuring devices required for each product based on its specifications and regulatory requirements.
Establish a schedule for regular calibration and maintenance of the monitoring and measuring devices to ensure accuracy and reliability.
Train personnel on the proper use and handling of monitoring and measuring devices to prevent errors in measurement.
Document the procedures for monitoring and measuring, including the criteria for conformity and the methods of measurement.
Review and update the monitoring and measuring processes periodically to incorporate improvements and changes in product requirements.

controls.name: general
controls.description: The organization shall plan and implement the monitoring, measurement, analysis and improvement processes needed to: a) demonstrate conformity of the product; b) ensure conformity of the quality management system; and c) continually improve the effectiveness of the quality management system.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive plan that outlines the monitoring and measurement processes for both product and quality management system conformity.
Assign responsibilities to team members for implementing and overseeing the monitoring and measurement activities.
Utilize appropriate tools and techniques for data collection and analysis to assess product and system performance.
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the quality management system and track improvements over time.
Conduct regular reviews of the monitoring and measurement processes to identify areas for enhancement and ensure alignment with organizational goals.

controls.name: monitoring and measurement
controls.description: The organization shall monitor and measure the characteristics of the product to verify that requirements have been met.

deployment_points.name: Define the specific characteristics of the product that need to be monitored and measured to ensure compliance with requirements.
Implement a systematic approach for collecting data on product characteristics during the production process.
Use statistical methods to analyze the collected data and determine if the product meets the established requirements.
Document the results of monitoring and measurement activities, including any deviations from requirements and corrective actions taken.
Regularly review monitoring and measurement results to identify trends and areas for improvement in product quality.

controls.name: control of nonconforming product
controls.description: The organization shall ensure that product which does not conform to product requirements is identified and controlled to prevent its unintended use or delivery.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear criteria for identifying nonconforming products based on product specifications and quality standards.
Implement a process for segregating nonconforming products from conforming products to prevent accidental use or delivery.
Document all instances of nonconformance, including the nature of the nonconformance and the actions taken to address it.
Train employees on the procedures for handling nonconforming products to ensure compliance with control measures.
Review and analyze nonconformance data regularly to identify root causes and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

controls.name: analysis of data
controls.description: The organization shall determine, collect and analyze appropriate data to demonstrate the suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system and to evaluate where continual improvement can be made.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of data that are relevant for assessing the quality management system's effectiveness and suitability.
Develop a data collection plan that specifies how and when data will be gathered from various sources.
Utilize analytical tools and techniques to evaluate the collected data and identify trends, patterns, and areas for improvement.
Document the findings from data analysis and communicate them to relevant stakeholders for informed decision-making.
Establish a feedback loop to ensure that insights gained from data analysis are used to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

controls.name: improvement
controls.description: The organization shall continually improve the effectiveness of the quality management system through the use of the quality policy, quality objectives, audit results, analysis of data, corrective actions and preventive actions.

deployment_points.name: Review the quality policy and objectives regularly to ensure they remain relevant and aligned with organizational goals.
Implement a structured process for conducting internal audits to assess the effectiveness of the quality management system.
Analyze audit results and data from monitoring activities to identify opportunities for improvement.
Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions based on identified issues to enhance system effectiveness.
Foster a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging employee involvement and feedback in quality management initiatives.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated according to the organization needs.

deployment_points.name: Define specific information security roles within the organization, ensuring clarity in responsibilities and expectations.
Allocate roles based on organizational needs, considering the skills and expertise of personnel.
Document the defined roles and responsibilities in an information security policy for reference.
Communicate the roles and responsibilities to all relevant personnel to ensure understanding and compliance.
Review and update the roles and responsibilities periodically to adapt to organizational changes.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: Conflicting duties and conflicting areas of responsibility shall be segregated.

deployment_points.name: Identify areas within the organization where conflicting duties may arise, such as access controls and data management.
Establish clear segregation of duties to minimize risks associated with conflicts, ensuring no single individual has control over all aspects of a critical process.
Document the segregation of duties in the organization's policies and procedures.
Train personnel on the importance of segregation of duties and how it applies to their roles.
Regularly audit and review the segregation of duties to ensure compliance and effectiveness.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established information security policy, topic-specific policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information security policy that outlines the expectations for all personnel regarding security practices.
Ensure that topic-specific policies and procedures are created to address particular areas of information security.
Communicate the policies and procedures to all personnel through training sessions and accessible documentation.
Implement a monitoring system to ensure compliance with the established policies and procedures.
Review and update the policies regularly to reflect changes in the organization or the threat landscape.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with relevant authorities.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement and regulatory bodies, that the organization should maintain contact with.
Establish formal communication channels with these authorities to facilitate information sharing and collaboration.
Designate specific personnel responsible for maintaining these contacts and ensure they are trained in communication protocols.
Document the established contacts and communication procedures in the organization's information security policy.
Regularly review and update the list of relevant authorities to ensure it remains current and effective.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: The organization shall establish and maintain contact with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, security forums, and professional associations that align with the organization's security interests.
Establish membership or participation in these groups to facilitate networking and information exchange.
Designate personnel to represent the organization in these forums and ensure they are knowledgeable about current security trends.
Document the established contacts and participation in these groups in the organization's information security strategy.
Regularly assess the value of these contacts and adjust participation as necessary to maximize benefits.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for collecting information on potential security threats from various sources, including internal and external data.
Analyze the collected data to identify patterns, trends, and potential threats to the organization.
Document the findings in a threat intelligence report that can be shared with relevant stakeholders.
Implement a system for disseminating threat intelligence to personnel responsible for security measures.
Regularly review and update the threat intelligence process to ensure it remains effective and relevant.

controls.name: threat intelligence
controls.description: Information security shall be integrated into project management.

deployment_points.name: Develop guidelines for integrating information security considerations into all phases of project management.
Train project managers and team members on the importance of incorporating security into project planning and execution.
Conduct risk assessments for projects to identify potential security vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies.
Document security requirements and controls as part of the project management documentation.
Review and evaluate the effectiveness of security integration in completed projects to inform future practices.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: An inventory of information and other associated assets, including owners, shall be developed and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive inventory of all information assets, including data, hardware, and software, along with their respective owners.
Implement a system for regularly updating the inventory to reflect changes in asset ownership or status.
Document the inventory in a secure and accessible format for authorized personnel.
Conduct periodic reviews of the inventory to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Train personnel on the importance of asset management and their responsibilities regarding the inventory.

controls.name: inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use and procedures for handling information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear rules and guidelines for the acceptable use of information and associated assets, tailored to the organization's needs.
Document these rules in an accessible format and ensure they are communicated to all personnel.
Implement training programs to educate personnel on acceptable use policies and the consequences of violations.
Establish monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the acceptable use rules.
Review and update the acceptable use policies regularly to address new risks and changes in technology.

controls.name: acceptable use of information and other associated assets
controls.description: Personnel and other interested parties as appropriate shall return all the organizationΓÇÖs assets in their possession upon change or termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear policy outlining the procedures for returning organizational assets upon employment termination or contract change.
Communicate the asset return policy to all personnel during onboarding and at regular intervals.
Designate responsible personnel to oversee the asset return process and ensure compliance.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the return of assets and document the condition of returned items.
Review and audit the asset return process regularly to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal policy outlining the classification of assets based on their confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements.
Identify and categorize all assets within the organization according to the established classification scheme.
Implement procedures for the return of classified assets, ensuring they are handled according to their classification level.
Train personnel on the importance of asset classification and the procedures for returning assets securely.
Regularly review and update the classification scheme and return procedures to ensure they remain effective and relevant.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish an information classification scheme that defines categories and criteria for labeling information.
Develop procedures for labeling information based on the classification scheme, including formats and methods of labeling.

Prioritize vulnerabilities based on risk assessment and implement remediation plans accordingly.
Stay informed about the latest security advisories and patches from vendors and apply them promptly.
Conduct regular training for IT staff on vulnerability management practices and the importance of timely updates.

controls.name: configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Develop a configuration management policy that outlines standards for all hardware and software configurations.
Use configuration management tools to automate the documentation and monitoring of configurations.
Regularly review and audit configurations to ensure compliance with established standards and policies.
Implement change management processes to control modifications to configurations and minimize risks.
Train staff on configuration management best practices and the importance of maintaining secure configurations.

controls.name: information deletion
controls.description: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.

deployment_points.name: Establish a data retention policy that defines how long different types of information should be kept.
Implement automated tools to securely delete information that is no longer required based on the retention policy.
Regularly review stored information to identify and delete data that is past its retention period.
Ensure that deletion processes comply with applicable legal and regulatory requirements for data disposal.
Train employees on the importance of data deletion and the procedures for securely removing information.

controls.name: data masking
controls.description: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organizationΓÇÖs topic-specific policy on access control and other related topic-specific policies, and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.

deployment_points.name: Develop a data masking policy that outlines when and how data masking should be applied.
Implement data masking techniques in systems that handle sensitive information to protect data privacy.
Regularly review and update data masking methods to ensure they meet current business and legal requirements.
Train staff on the importance of data masking and how to apply it effectively in their workflows.
Monitor the effectiveness of data masking solutions and adjust as necessary to address new risks.

controls.name: data leakage prevention
controls.description: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.

deployment_points.name: Identify sensitive information across all systems and networks to determine where data leakage prevention measures are necessary.
Implement data loss prevention (DLP) tools that monitor and control data transfers, ensuring sensitive data is not sent outside the organization without authorization.
Establish policies and procedures for handling sensitive information, including encryption and access controls to prevent unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update DLP measures to adapt to new threats and changes in the data landscape.
Train employees on data leakage prevention practices and the importance of safeguarding sensitive information.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods for backing up information and systems.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of critical data and systems.
Store backup copies in secure, offsite locations to protect against data loss due to physical disasters.
Regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure data can be recovered quickly and accurately when needed.
Document and review backup procedures periodically to ensure compliance with the backup policy and address any identified gaps.

controls.name: redundancy of information processing facilities
controls.description: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

deployment_points.name: Assess the availability requirements of critical information processing facilities to determine necessary redundancy levels.
Implement redundant systems, such as failover servers and load balancers, to ensure continuous operation during failures.
Regularly test redundancy mechanisms to verify that they function correctly and can handle failover scenarios.
Monitor the performance of redundant systems to ensure they are operating effectively and efficiently.
Document redundancy strategies and update them as necessary to reflect changes in technology or business needs.

controls.name: logging
controls.description: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.

deployment_points.name: Establish logging policies that define what events should be logged, including user activities, system errors, and security incidents.
Implement logging mechanisms across all systems and applications to capture relevant data in real-time.
Store logs securely to prevent unauthorized access and ensure their integrity for future analysis.
Regularly review and analyze logs to identify anomalies or security incidents that require further investigation.
Retain logs for a defined period in accordance with regulatory requirements and organizational policies.

controls.name: monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools that provide real-time visibility into network traffic, system performance, and application behavior.
Define baseline behavior for systems and networks to identify deviations that may indicate security incidents.
Establish incident response procedures to follow when anomalous behavior is detected, including escalation protocols.
Regularly review monitoring configurations and thresholds to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.
Train staff on monitoring tools and incident response processes to ensure timely and effective action when anomalies are detected.

controls.name: clock synchronization
controls.description: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.

deployment_points.name: Identify and configure approved time sources, such as NTP servers, for synchronizing clocks across all information processing systems.
Implement automated synchronization processes to ensure that all systems maintain accurate time settings.
Regularly verify the accuracy of system clocks and the functionality of synchronization mechanisms.
Document the time synchronization process and any deviations from the standard to maintain compliance.
Educate staff on the importance of time synchronization for security logging and incident response.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs in use within the organization and assess their necessity for operational tasks.
Implement strict access controls to limit the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Monitor and log the usage of privileged utility programs to detect any unauthorized or suspicious activities.
Regularly review and update the list of approved utility programs to ensure compliance with security policies.
Provide training to users on the risks associated with privileged utility programs and the importance of adhering to access controls.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal software installation policy that outlines the approval process and security requirements for new software.
Implement a change management process to review and approve software installations before they are executed.
Use automated tools to manage software installations and ensure that only approved software is deployed on operational systems.
Regularly audit installed software to identify unauthorized or outdated applications that may pose security risks.
Train staff on the software installation policy and the importance of maintaining a secure operational environment.

controls.name: network security
controls.description: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in the network and prioritize security measures accordingly.
Implement firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and other security technologies to protect network perimeters and internal segments.
Regularly update and patch network devices to protect against known vulnerabilities and exploits.
Monitor network traffic for suspicious activities and respond promptly to potential security incidents.
Document network security policies and procedures, ensuring they are communicated to all relevant personnel.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.

deployment_points.name: Identify all network services in use and assess their security requirements based on organizational policies and compliance needs.
Implement security mechanisms such as encryption, authentication, and access controls for all network services.
Define service level agreements (SLAs) that outline security expectations and performance metrics for network services.
Regularly monitor network services for compliance with security policies and SLAs, addressing any deviations promptly.
Provide training to staff on the security requirements of network services and the importance of adhering to established protocols.

controls.name: segregation of networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organizationΓÇÖs networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize all information services, users, and information systems within the organization.
Design network architecture to create distinct segments for different groups based on their security requirements.
Implement firewalls and access control lists to enforce segregation between network segments.
Regularly review and update network segmentation policies to adapt to changes in the organization.
Monitor network traffic between segments to detect and respond to unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: web filtering
controls.description: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

deployment_points.name: Select and deploy a web filtering solution that aligns with organizational security policies.
Configure the filtering solution to block access to known malicious websites and categories deemed inappropriate.
Regularly update the filtering rules and threat intelligence feeds to ensure effectiveness against new threats.
Educate users on the importance of web filtering and safe browsing practices.
Monitor and log web access attempts to identify potential security incidents and adjust filtering policies accordingly.

controls.name: use of cryptography
controls.description: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Establish a cryptographic policy that defines the types of data requiring encryption and the cryptographic methods to be used.
Implement key management practices that include key generation, distribution, storage, and destruction.
Train personnel on the importance of cryptography and the proper handling of cryptographic keys.
Regularly review and update cryptographic algorithms and key lengths to comply with industry standards.
Monitor the use of cryptographic systems to detect and respond to any anomalies or breaches.

controls.name: secure development life cycle
controls.description: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.

deployment_points.name: Define a secure development life cycle (SDLC) framework that integrates security at each phase of development.
Train development teams on secure coding practices and the importance of security in software development.
Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments during the design phase to identify potential vulnerabilities.
Implement security testing procedures, including static and dynamic analysis, throughout the development process.
Review and update the SDLC regularly to incorporate lessons learned and emerging security threats.

controls.name: application security requirements
controls.description: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting security requirements for all new applications.
Involve stakeholders from security, development, and business units in the requirements gathering process.
Review and approve security requirements before development or acquisition begins to ensure alignment with organizational policies.
Conduct regular audits of applications to ensure compliance with defined security requirements.
Update security requirements as necessary to address new threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: secure system architecture principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activities.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document secure system architecture principles that align with organizational security goals.
Ensure that all system development activities adhere to these principles from the initial design phase through deployment.
Conduct regular training sessions for architects and developers on secure architecture practices.
Review and update architecture principles periodically to reflect changes in technology and threat landscape.
Implement a review process to assess compliance with secure architecture principles during system development.

controls.name: secure coding
controls.description: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.

deployment_points.name: Define and document secure coding standards that all developers must follow during software development.
Provide training for developers on secure coding practices and common vulnerabilities.
Implement code review processes to ensure adherence to secure coding standards before code is merged.
Utilize automated tools to scan for security vulnerabilities in the codebase during development.
Regularly update secure coding standards to address new vulnerabilities and best practices.

controls.name: security testing in development and acceptance
controls.description: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

deployment_points.name: Establish a security testing strategy that outlines testing methods and tools to be used throughout the development life cycle.
Integrate security testing into the continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipeline to ensure ongoing assessment.
Train development and testing teams on security testing methodologies and tools.
Document and track security testing results, including vulnerabilities found and remediation efforts.
Review and refine security testing processes regularly to improve effectiveness and adapt to new threats.

controls.name: outsourced development
controls.description: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear guidelines and expectations for security and quality in outsourced development contracts.
Monitor the progress of outsourced development projects through regular status meetings and reporting.
Conduct security assessments of the outsourced development processes and deliverables.
Ensure that outsourced developers are trained on the organizationΓÇÖs security policies and practices.
Review and evaluate the performance of outsourced development partners regularly to ensure compliance with security requirements.

controls.name: development, testing and production environments
controls.description: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.

deployment_points.name: Create distinct environments for development, testing, and production to prevent unauthorized access and changes.
Implement access controls to restrict personnel access to each environment based on their role and necessity.
