Regularly audit and monitor the environments to ensure compliance with security policies and detect any unauthorized changes.
Establish procedures for promoting code from development to testing and production that include security checks.
Document and maintain the configurations of each environment to ensure consistency and security.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management policy that outlines the procedures for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes to information systems.
Implement a change request system where all proposed changes are documented, including the rationale, impact analysis, and approval status.
Ensure that all changes are tested in a controlled environment before deployment to minimize risks to operational systems.
Conduct regular reviews of change management processes to ensure compliance with the policy and to identify areas for improvement.
Train relevant personnel on change management procedures to ensure consistent application and understanding across the organization.

controls.name: test information
controls.description: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.

deployment_points.name: Define criteria for selecting test information to ensure it is relevant and representative of production data while minimizing exposure of sensitive information.
Implement access controls to restrict who can view and use test information, ensuring that only authorized personnel have access.
Establish procedures for the secure storage and transmission of test information to protect it from unauthorized access or breaches.
Regularly review and update test information management practices to align with data protection regulations and organizational policies.
Provide training for staff on the importance of protecting test information and the specific procedures in place to manage it securely.

controls.name: protection of information systems during audit testing
controls.description: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal audit testing plan that outlines the scope, objectives, and methodologies to be used during the assessment of operational systems.
Schedule meetings between auditors and management to discuss and agree on the audit plan, ensuring alignment on expectations and resource availability.
Implement safeguards to protect operational systems during testing, including limiting access to sensitive areas and ensuring data integrity.
Document all findings and recommendations from the audit testing process, and ensure they are communicated to relevant stakeholders for action.
Conduct follow-up reviews to ensure that management has addressed any issues identified during the audit testing and to assess the effectiveness of implemented changes.

controls.name: policies for information security
controls.description: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published and communicated to employees and relevant external parties.

deployment_points.name: Define a comprehensive set of information security policies that cover all relevant aspects of security management.
Obtain formal approval from senior management to ensure alignment with organizational objectives and compliance requirements.
Publish the approved policies in accessible formats and locations, such as the company intranet or employee handbooks.
Communicate the policies to all employees and relevant external parties through training sessions, emails, and meetings to ensure understanding and compliance.
Establish a process for ongoing communication and updates regarding the policies to keep all stakeholders informed of any changes.

controls.name: review of the policies for information security
controls.description: The policies for information security shall be reviewed at planned intervals or if significant changes occur to ensure their continuing suitability, adequacy and effectiveness.

deployment_points.name: Schedule regular review intervals for the information security policies, such as annually or bi-annually, to ensure they remain relevant.
Identify triggers for unscheduled reviews, such as significant organizational changes, incidents, or regulatory updates.
Assemble a review team comprising stakeholders from various departments to assess the policies' effectiveness and relevance.
Document the findings of each review, including any necessary updates or changes to the policies.
Communicate the results of the review and any changes made to all employees and relevant external parties to ensure continued awareness and compliance.

controls.name: information security roles and responsibilities
controls.description: All information security responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.

deployment_points.name: Identify all roles within the organization that have responsibilities related to information security, including IT, HR, and management.
Clearly define the specific information security responsibilities for each role to avoid ambiguity and overlap.
Document the roles and responsibilities in an accessible format, such as a policy document or organizational chart.
Communicate the defined roles and responsibilities to all employees to ensure understanding and accountability.
Regularly review and update the roles and responsibilities to reflect changes in the organization or security landscape.

controls.name: segregation of duties
controls.description: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated to reduce opportunities for unauthorized or unintentional modification or misuse of the organizationΓÇÖs assets.

deployment_points.name: Identify key processes and functions within the organization that require segregation of duties to mitigate risks.
Define and document the specific roles and responsibilities that should be separated to prevent conflicts of interest.
Implement access controls and system configurations that enforce the segregation of duties in relevant systems and processes.
Train employees on the importance of segregation of duties and the specific practices in place to uphold this principle.
Regularly audit and review the segregation of duties to ensure compliance and address any identified issues.

controls.name: contact with authorities
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant authorities, such as law enforcement, regulatory bodies, and industry associations, that the organization should maintain contact with.
Establish a list of key contacts within these authorities, including their roles and contact information.
Develop a communication plan that outlines how and when to engage with these authorities, including reporting incidents or seeking guidance.
Designate specific personnel within the organization responsible for maintaining these contacts and ensuring effective communication.
Regularly review and update the contact list and communication plan to reflect any changes in personnel or authority requirements.

controls.name: contact with special interest groups
controls.description: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums and professional associations shall be maintained.

deployment_points.name: Identify relevant special interest groups, forums, and professional associations related to information security that the organization can engage with.
Establish a list of key contacts within these groups, including their roles and contact information.
Develop a strategy for participation in these groups, including attending meetings, conferences, and contributing to discussions.
Designate personnel responsible for maintaining relationships with these groups and ensuring the organization benefits from shared knowledge and resources.
Regularly review and update the list of contacts and participation strategies to ensure continued relevance and engagement.

controls.name: information security in project management
controls.description: Information security shall be addressed in project management, regardless of the type of the project.

deployment_points.name: Integrate information security requirements into the project management framework and methodologies used within the organization.
Define specific security roles and responsibilities for project teams to ensure accountability for security considerations.
Conduct risk assessments for each project to identify potential security threats and vulnerabilities.
Develop and implement security plans that outline the measures to be taken to protect information throughout the project lifecycle.
Review and evaluate the effectiveness of security measures in completed projects to inform future project management practices.

controls.name: mobile device policy
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be adopted to manage the risks introduced by using mobile devices.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive mobile device policy that outlines acceptable use, security requirements, and responsibilities for employees.
Implement technical controls such as encryption, remote wipe capabilities, and access restrictions to protect sensitive data on mobile devices.
Provide training to employees on the mobile device policy and best practices for securing their devices.
Regularly review and update the mobile device policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor compliance with the mobile device policy through audits and assessments to ensure adherence and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: teleworking
controls.description: A policy and supporting security measures shall be implemented to protect information accessed, processed or stored at teleworking sites.

deployment_points.name: Develop a teleworking policy that outlines security requirements, acceptable use, and responsibilities for employees working remotely.
Implement security measures such as VPNs, secure access controls, and data encryption to protect information accessed from teleworking sites.
Provide training to employees on the teleworking policy and best practices for securing information while working remotely.
Regularly review and update the teleworking policy to address new risks and changes in the remote work environment.
Monitor compliance with the teleworking policy through assessments and feedback to ensure ongoing security and effectiveness.

controls.name: screening
controls.description: Background verification checks on all candidates for employment shall be carried out in accordance with relevant laws, regulations and ethics and shall be proportional to the business requirements, the classification of the information to be accessed and the perceived risks.

deployment_points.name: Establish a background verification policy that outlines the types of checks to be conducted based on the role and information access level.
Ensure compliance with relevant laws and regulations regarding background checks, including privacy and discrimination laws.
Implement a standardized process for conducting background checks, including documentation and record-keeping.
Train HR personnel and hiring managers on the background verification process and the importance of security in hiring decisions.
Regularly review and update the background verification policy and processes to ensure they remain effective and compliant with changing regulations.

controls.name: terms and conditions of employment
controls.description: The contractual agreements with employees and contractors shall state their and the organizationΓÇÖs responsibilities for information security.

deployment_points.name: Draft clear contractual agreements that outline both employee and organizational responsibilities regarding information security.
Ensure that all contracts are reviewed by legal and compliance teams to meet regulatory requirements.
Communicate the terms and conditions to all new hires during the onboarding process.
Maintain a repository of all signed contracts for easy access and auditing purposes.
Regularly review and update the terms to reflect changes in policies or regulations.

controls.name: management responsibilities
controls.description: Management shall require all employees and contractors to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures of the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop and disseminate clear information security policies and procedures to all employees and contractors.
Conduct regular training sessions to ensure understanding and compliance with these policies.
Implement a monitoring system to track adherence to information security practices.
Establish a feedback mechanism for employees to report challenges or suggestions regarding security practices.
Hold management accountable for enforcing compliance and addressing violations.

controls.name: information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: All employees of the organization and, where relevant, contractors shall receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates in organizational policies and procedures, as relevant for their job function.

deployment_points.name: Create a comprehensive training program that covers information security awareness tailored to different job functions.
Schedule regular training sessions and updates to keep employees informed of new threats and policies.
Utilize various training methods, such as e-learning, workshops, and simulations, to enhance engagement.
Track attendance and completion rates to ensure all employees participate in the training.
Evaluate the effectiveness of training through assessments and feedback to continuously improve the program.

controls.name: disciplinary process
controls.description: There shall be a formal and communicated disciplinary process in place to take action against employees who have committed an information security breach.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal disciplinary policy that outlines the consequences of information security breaches.
Communicate the disciplinary process to all employees during onboarding and through regular reminders.
Ensure that the process includes clear steps for investigation and appeals to maintain fairness.
Train management on how to implement the disciplinary process consistently and fairly.
Regularly review and update the disciplinary policy to ensure it remains effective and compliant with legal standards.

controls.name: termination or change of employment responsibilities
controls.description: Information security responsibilities and duties that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, communicated to the employee or contractor and enforced.

deployment_points.name: Define and document the information security responsibilities that persist post-termination or change of employment.
Communicate these responsibilities clearly to employees during exit interviews or transition meetings.
Implement a process to revoke access to systems and data immediately upon termination.
Ensure that all departing employees sign an acknowledgment of their ongoing responsibilities regarding information security.
Regularly review and update the policies to reflect any changes in organizational structure or legal requirements.

controls.name: inventory of assets
controls.description: Assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified and an inventory of these assets shall be drawn up and maintained.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a comprehensive assessment to identify all information assets and processing facilities within the organization.
Create and maintain an up-to-date inventory that includes details such as asset type, owner, and location.
Implement a regular review process to ensure the inventory remains accurate and complete.
Utilize asset management software to streamline the tracking and management of assets.
Train staff on the importance of asset management and their role in maintaining the inventory.

controls.name: ownership of assets
controls.description: Assets maintained in the inventory shall be owned.

deployment_points.name: Assign clear ownership for each asset listed in the inventory to ensure accountability.
Document the responsibilities of asset owners regarding the protection and management of their assets.
Regularly review ownership assignments to ensure they are current and reflect organizational changes.
Communicate ownership responsibilities to all relevant stakeholders to promote awareness.
Implement a process for transferring ownership when employees leave or change roles.

controls.name: acceptable use of assets
controls.description: Rules for the acceptable use of information and of assets associated with information and information processing facilities shall be identified, documented and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a clear acceptable use policy that outlines the rules for using organizational assets and information.
Communicate the policy to all employees and contractors during onboarding and through regular training.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure compliance with the acceptable use policy.
Establish consequences for violations of the policy to deter misuse of assets.
Regularly review and update the acceptable use policy to address emerging threats and changes in technology.

controls.name: return of assets
controls.description: All employees and external party users shall return all of the organizational assets in their possession upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal process for the return of organizational assets upon termination or contract completion.
Communicate the asset return policy to all employees and external users during onboarding.
Create a checklist of assets to be returned to ensure completeness during the exit process.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the return of assets and follow up on outstanding items.
Regularly review the asset return process to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance.

controls.name: classification of information
controls.description: Information shall be classified in terms of legal requirements, value, criticality and sensitivity to unauthorized disclosure or modification.

deployment_points.name: Develop a classification scheme that categorizes information based on legal, value, criticality, and sensitivity criteria.
Train employees on how to classify information correctly according to the established scheme.
Implement a process for regularly reviewing and updating information classifications as needed.
Ensure that classified information is handled according to its classification level, including access controls and storage requirements.
Document and communicate the classification scheme to all employees to promote compliance.

controls.name: labelling of information
controls.description: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive information classification scheme that defines categories and sensitivity levels of information.
Create labelling procedures that specify how information should be marked based on its classification level.
Train employees on the importance of information labelling and the procedures to follow for consistent application.
Implement a review process to ensure that information is labelled correctly and consistently across the organization.
Regularly update labelling procedures to reflect changes in the classification scheme or regulatory requirements.

controls.name: handling of assets
controls.description: Procedures for handling assets shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the information classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish clear procedures for the handling of assets based on their classification, including storage, access, and transfer protocols.
Identify and categorize all assets according to the information classification scheme to ensure appropriate handling.
Train staff on the procedures for handling assets, emphasizing the importance of compliance with the classification scheme.
Monitor and audit asset handling practices to ensure adherence to established procedures and identify areas for improvement.
Review and update handling procedures regularly to align with changes in the classification scheme or organizational policies.

controls.name: management of removable media
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented for the management of removable media in accordance with the classification scheme adopted by the organization.

deployment_points.name: Develop procedures for the secure management of removable media, including encryption and access controls based on classification levels.
Classify all removable media according to the organization's information classification scheme to determine handling requirements.
Train employees on the proper use and management of removable media, including security measures and reporting incidents.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the distribution and return of removable media to prevent loss or unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update removable media management procedures to ensure they remain effective and compliant with security policies.

controls.name: disposal of media
controls.description: Media shall be disposed of securely when no longer required, using formal procedures.

deployment_points.name: Establish formal procedures for the secure disposal of media, including methods such as shredding or degaussing.
Classify media according to the information classification scheme to determine the appropriate disposal method.
Train staff on disposal procedures to ensure compliance and understanding of the importance of secure media disposal.
Maintain a log of disposed media, including details of the media type, disposal method, and personnel involved in the process.
Regularly review and update disposal procedures to ensure they meet current security standards and regulatory requirements.

controls.name: physical media transfer
controls.description: Media containing information shall be protected against unauthorized access, misuse or corruption during transportation.

deployment_points.name: Develop procedures for the secure transportation of media, including the use of tamper-evident packaging and secure transport methods.
Classify media according to the information classification scheme to determine the level of protection required during transfer.
Train employees on secure media transfer procedures, emphasizing the importance of protecting sensitive information.
Implement a tracking system to monitor the movement of media during transportation to ensure accountability.
Regularly review and update transfer procedures to address emerging threats and ensure compliance with security policies.

controls.name: access control policy
controls.description: An access control policy shall be established, documented and reviewed based on business and information security requirements.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive access control policy that outlines user access rights based on business needs and security requirements.
Document the access control policy and ensure it is easily accessible to all relevant stakeholders within the organization.
Conduct regular reviews of the access control policy to ensure it remains aligned with business objectives and security standards.
Train employees on the access control policy, including their responsibilities and the importance of adhering to it.
Implement a process for monitoring and auditing access control compliance to identify and address any violations.

controls.name: access to networks and network services
controls.description: Users shall only be provided with access to the network and network services that they have been specifically authorized to use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a user access request process that requires formal approval for access to network services based on job roles.
Implement technical controls to enforce access restrictions, ensuring users can only access authorized network resources.
Regularly review user access rights to ensure they remain appropriate and revoke access for users who no longer require it.
Train employees on the importance of access control and the procedures for requesting and managing access to network services.
Monitor network access logs to detect unauthorized access attempts and take corrective actions as necessary.

controls.name: user registration and de-registration
controls.description: A formal user registration and de-registration process shall be implemented to enable assignment of access rights.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal user registration process that includes identity verification and approval for new user accounts.
Implement a de-registration process to promptly revoke access rights for users who leave the organization or change roles.
Maintain a record of all user registrations and de-registrations to ensure accountability and compliance.
Train staff on the registration and de-registration processes to ensure they understand their roles and responsibilities.
Regularly review and update the registration and de-registration processes to align with changes in organizational policies.

controls.name: user access provisioning
controls.description: A formal user access provisioning process shall be implemented to assign or revoke access rights for all user types to all systems and services.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal access provisioning process that includes criteria for assigning and revoking access rights based on user roles.
Implement a system for tracking access rights assignments and changes to ensure accurate record-keeping.
Train employees on the access provisioning process, emphasizing the importance of following established procedures.
Conduct regular audits of access rights to ensure compliance with the provisioning process and identify any discrepancies.
Review and update the access provisioning process regularly to adapt to changes in technology and organizational needs.

controls.name: management of privileged access rights
controls.description: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and controlled.

deployment_points.name: Develop a policy for the management of privileged access rights, outlining criteria for granting and revoking such access.
Implement technical controls to restrict privileged access to only those users who require it for their job functions.
Train staff on the importance of managing privileged access and the procedures for requesting and using such rights.
Regularly review and audit privileged access rights to ensure compliance with the management policy and identify any unauthorized access.
Update the privileged access management policy and procedures regularly to reflect changes in organizational structure and security requirements.

controls.name: management of secret authentication information of users
controls.description: The allocation of secret authentication information shall be controlled through a formal management process.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal process for the allocation and management of secret authentication information, including roles and responsibilities.
Implement a secure method for generating and distributing secret authentication information to users.
Maintain a centralized repository for tracking the allocation and status of secret authentication information.
Regularly review and update the management process to ensure compliance with security policies and best practices.
Train users on the importance of safeguarding their secret authentication information and the procedures for reporting any security incidents.

controls.name: review of user access rights
controls.description: Asset owners shall review usersΓÇÖ access rights at regular intervals.

deployment_points.name: Define a schedule for regular reviews of user access rights, such as quarterly or bi-annually.
Assign asset owners the responsibility to conduct these reviews and ensure they have the necessary tools and information.
Document the review process, including criteria for access rights and any changes made during the review.
Implement a mechanism for users to request changes to their access rights and for asset owners to approve or deny these requests.
Report the results of the access rights reviews to management and take corrective actions for any discrepancies found.

controls.name: removal or adjustment of access rights
controls.description: The access rights of all employees and external party users to information and information processing facilities shall be removed upon termination of their employment, contract or agreement, or adjusted upon change.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal procedure for the timely removal or adjustment of access rights upon termination or change of employment status.
Ensure that HR and IT departments are coordinated to promptly communicate changes in employment status.
Implement automated systems to revoke access rights immediately upon termination or change of role.
Conduct regular audits to verify that access rights have been appropriately removed or adjusted as per the established procedures.
Maintain records of access rights changes for compliance and auditing purposes.

controls.name: use of secret authentication information
controls.description: Users shall be required to follow the organizationΓÇÖs practices in the use of secret authentication information.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document clear guidelines on the proper use of secret authentication information for all users.
Provide training sessions to educate users on the importance of following these practices and the risks of non-compliance.
Implement monitoring mechanisms to ensure adherence to the established practices regarding secret authentication information.
Establish a reporting process for users to report any suspected misuse or compromise of secret authentication information.
Regularly review and update the guidelines to reflect changes in technology and security threats.

controls.name: information access restriction
controls.description: Access to information and application system functions shall be restricted in accordance with the access control policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop an access control policy that clearly defines user roles and the corresponding access levels required for information and application systems.
Implement technical controls to enforce the access restrictions defined in the policy, such as role-based access control (RBAC).
Regularly review and update the access control policy to ensure it remains relevant and effective against emerging threats.
Train users on the access control policy and the importance of adhering to access restrictions.
Monitor access logs to detect and respond to any unauthorized access attempts.

controls.name: secure log-on procedures
controls.description: Where required by the access control policy, access to systems and applications shall be controlled by a secure log-on procedure.

deployment_points.name: Define secure log-on procedures that include multi-factor authentication where appropriate.
Implement technical solutions to enforce these log-on procedures across all systems and applications.
Regularly test and update the log-on procedures to address any vulnerabilities or weaknesses.
Provide user training on the secure log-on procedures and the importance of maintaining log-in security.
Monitor log-on attempts and establish alerts for suspicious activities or repeated failed log-in attempts.

controls.name: password management system
controls.description: Password management systems shall be interactive and shall ensure quality passwords.

deployment_points.name: Implement an interactive password management system that enforces strong password policies, including complexity and length requirements.
Provide users with guidance on creating secure passwords and the importance of password uniqueness.
Regularly review and update the password management system to incorporate best practices and address security vulnerabilities.
Monitor password usage and implement measures to detect and respond to weak or compromised passwords.
Educate users on the importance of changing passwords regularly and provide reminders for password updates.

controls.name: use of privileged utility programs
controls.description: The use of utility programs that might be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Identify all privileged utility programs and assess their potential risks to system and application controls.
Develop a policy that restricts the use of these programs to authorized personnel only.
Implement logging and monitoring of all activities involving privileged utility programs to detect unauthorized use.
Provide training to authorized users on the proper use and risks associated with privileged utility programs.
Regularly review and audit the use of privileged utility programs to ensure compliance with the established policy.

controls.name: access control to program source code
controls.description: Access to program source code shall be restricted.

deployment_points.name: Establish a policy that defines who can access program source code and under what circumstances.
Implement access controls to restrict source code access to authorized personnel only, using role-based permissions.
Maintain an audit trail of all access to program source code to monitor for unauthorized access.
Regularly review access permissions to ensure they are appropriate and up-to-date.
Provide training to developers and authorized personnel on the importance of source code security and the risks of unauthorized access.

controls.name: policy on the use of cryptographic controls
controls.description: A policy on the use of cryptographic controls for protection of information shall be developed and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive policy outlining the use of cryptographic controls for protecting sensitive information.
Identify the types of information that require cryptographic protection and the appropriate cryptographic methods to be used.
Implement the policy across the organization, ensuring all relevant personnel are aware of and trained on its requirements.
Regularly review and update the cryptographic policy to adapt to new threats and technological advancements.
Monitor compliance with the cryptographic policy and conduct audits to ensure effective implementation.

controls.name: key management
controls.description: A policy on the use, protection and lifetime of cryptographic keys shall be developed and implemented through their whole lifecycle.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive key management policy that outlines the procedures for key generation, distribution, storage, and destruction.
Implement a secure key storage solution, such as a hardware security module (HSM), to protect cryptographic keys from unauthorized access.
Establish a key lifecycle management process that includes regular audits and reviews of key usage and access logs.
Train personnel on key management best practices and the importance of safeguarding cryptographic keys throughout their lifecycle.
Regularly update the key management policy to reflect changes in technology, threats, and organizational requirements.

controls.name: physical security perimeter
controls.description: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain either sensitive or critical information and information processing facilities.

deployment_points.name: Identify and map out all areas containing sensitive or critical information to establish clear security perimeters.
Install physical barriers such as fences, walls, or gates to delineate the security perimeter and restrict unauthorized access.
Implement surveillance systems, such as CCTV cameras, to monitor the security perimeter and detect any unauthorized entry attempts.
Establish access control measures, including security personnel and identification checks, at all entry points to the defined perimeter.
Regularly review and update the security perimeter based on changes in facility layout or security threats.

controls.name: physical entry controls
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls to ensure that only authorized personnel are allowed access.

deployment_points.name: Implement access control systems, such as key cards or biometric scanners, to restrict entry to secure areas.
Maintain an up-to-date list of authorized personnel who are permitted access to secure areas and regularly review this list.
Train security staff on entry control procedures and the importance of verifying the identity of individuals seeking access.
Establish visitor management protocols, including sign-in procedures and escort requirements for non-authorized personnel.
Conduct regular audits of entry control systems to ensure compliance and identify any potential vulnerabilities.

controls.name: securing offices, rooms and facilities
controls.description: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify vulnerabilities in offices, rooms, and facilities that require physical security measures.
Install locks, security doors, and window bars to enhance physical security in sensitive areas.
Implement an alarm system to alert personnel of unauthorized access or breaches in security.
Ensure that all security measures are regularly tested and maintained to ensure their effectiveness.
Develop and communicate emergency response plans for incidents related to physical security breaches.

controls.name: protecting against external and environmental threats
controls.description: Physical protection against natural disasters, malicious attack or accidents shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a risk assessment to identify potential external and environmental threats to the facility.
Implement structural reinforcements, such as flood barriers or seismic bracing, to protect against natural disasters.
Install fire suppression systems and ensure that fire exits are clearly marked and accessible.
Develop and regularly test disaster recovery and business continuity plans to address potential incidents.
Train employees on emergency procedures and the importance of reporting any environmental hazards.

controls.name: working in secure areas
controls.description: Procedures for working in secure areas shall be designed and applied.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear procedures for employees working in secure areas, including access protocols and safety measures.
Provide training to employees on the specific security requirements and responsibilities when working in secure areas.
Implement a monitoring system to ensure compliance with established procedures and identify any deviations.
Regularly review and update procedures based on feedback from employees and changes in security threats.
Establish a reporting mechanism for employees to report security incidents or concerns while working in secure areas.

controls.name: delivery and loading areas
controls.description: Access points such as delivery and loading areas and other points where unauthorized persons could enter the premises shall be controlled and, if possible, isolated from information processing facilities to avoid unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Designate specific delivery and loading areas that are separate from sensitive information processing facilities.
Implement access control measures, such as security personnel or electronic gates, to monitor and restrict access to delivery areas.
Train staff on procedures for receiving deliveries, including verification of delivery personnel and inspection of packages.
Install surveillance cameras in delivery areas to monitor activities and deter unauthorized access.
Regularly review and update access control measures based on changes in delivery processes or security threats.

controls.name: equipment siting and protection
controls.description: Equipment shall be sited and protected to reduce the risks from environmental threats and hazards, and opportunities for unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Conduct a site assessment to determine the optimal location for equipment to minimize exposure to environmental threats.
Install physical barriers, such as locked cabinets or cages, to protect sensitive equipment from unauthorized access.
Ensure that equipment is placed away from windows, doors, and other potential points of vulnerability.
Implement environmental controls, such as temperature and humidity monitoring, to protect equipment from environmental hazards.
Regularly review equipment siting and protection measures to ensure they remain effective against evolving threats.

controls.name: supporting utilities
controls.description: Equipment shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

deployment_points.name: Install uninterruptible power supplies (UPS) to provide backup power to critical equipment during outages.
Regularly test and maintain UPS systems to ensure they are functioning properly and can support equipment during power failures.
Implement redundancy for critical utilities, such as backup generators, to minimize the impact of utility failures.
Monitor utility performance and establish alerts for any disruptions to proactively address potential issues.
Develop and communicate contingency plans for responding to utility failures and ensuring continuity of operations.

controls.name: cabling security
controls.description: Power and telecommunications cabling carrying data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.

deployment_points.name: Route cabling through secure pathways, such as conduits or cable trays, to minimize exposure to unauthorized access.
Use tamper-evident seals and secure enclosures for cabling to prevent interception or damage.
Regularly inspect cabling for signs of wear, damage, or tampering and address any issues promptly.
Implement monitoring systems to detect unauthorized access or interference with cabling.
Train personnel on the importance of cabling security and best practices for maintaining the integrity of data transmission.

controls.name: equipment maintenance
controls.description: Equipment shall be correctly maintained to ensure its continued availability and integrity.

deployment_points.name: Establish a maintenance schedule for all equipment, detailing frequency and types of maintenance required.
Assign qualified personnel to perform maintenance tasks and ensure they are trained on the specific equipment.
Document all maintenance activities, including dates, actions taken, and any issues identified during maintenance.
Implement a tracking system to monitor equipment performance and maintenance history to identify trends or recurring issues.
Review and update maintenance procedures regularly to incorporate lessons learned and changes in equipment or technology.

controls.name: removal of assets
controls.description: Equipment, information or software shall not be taken off-site without prior authorization.

deployment_points.name: Develop a formal policy outlining the process for requesting authorization to remove assets from the premises.
Create a standardized asset removal form that includes details such as the asset type, purpose of removal, and duration.
Designate an approval authority responsible for reviewing and granting or denying asset removal requests.
Maintain a log of all approved and denied requests to ensure accountability and traceability.
Conduct regular audits to ensure compliance with the asset removal policy and address any unauthorized removals.

controls.name: security of equipment and assets off-premises
controls.description: Security shall be applied to off-site assets taking into account the different risks of working outside the organizationΓÇÖs premises.

deployment_points.name: Assess the risks associated with off-site work and develop security measures tailored to those risks.
Provide employees with guidelines on securing equipment and assets when working off-premises, including physical security and data protection measures.
Implement encryption for sensitive data stored on portable devices to protect against unauthorized access.
Require employees to report any loss or theft of off-site assets immediately to ensure prompt response and mitigation.
Regularly review and update off-site security policies to adapt to changing risks and technologies.

controls.name: secure disposal or reuse of equipment
controls.description: All items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

deployment_points.name: Establish a secure disposal policy that outlines procedures for handling equipment containing sensitive data.
Use certified data destruction methods to ensure that all sensitive information is irretrievable before disposal or reuse.
Maintain records of all disposed or reused equipment, including the method of data destruction and the personnel involved.
Train staff on the importance of secure disposal practices and the potential risks of improper handling of sensitive data.
Conduct periodic audits to verify compliance with the secure disposal policy and identify areas for improvement.

controls.name: unattended user equipment
controls.description: Users shall ensure that unattended equipment has appropriate protection.

deployment_points.name: Implement automatic screen lock features on all devices to activate after a specified period of inactivity.
Educate users on the importance of securing their equipment when unattended, including locking screens and securing physical devices.
Establish a policy that requires users to log off or shut down equipment when leaving it unattended for extended periods.
Conduct regular training sessions to reinforce best practices for protecting unattended equipment and the risks of negligence.
Monitor compliance with the unattended equipment policy and address any violations through appropriate disciplinary measures.

controls.name: clear desk and clear screen policy
controls.description: A clear desk policy for papers and removable storage media and a clear screen policy for information processing facilities shall be adopted.

deployment_points.name: Develop and communicate a clear desk and clear screen policy that outlines expectations for maintaining a secure workspace.
Provide training to employees on the importance of keeping desks clear of sensitive information and securing screens when not in use.
Implement regular checks to ensure compliance with the clear desk and screen policy, providing feedback and corrective actions as necessary.
Encourage the use of secure storage solutions for sensitive documents and removable media to minimize exposure.
Review and update the policy periodically to address new security challenges and reinforce its importance.

controls.name: documented operating procedures
controls.description: Operating procedures shall be documented and made available to all users who need them.

deployment_points.name: Identify all critical operational procedures that require documentation and assign responsible personnel for each.
Create clear, concise, and accessible documentation for each procedure, ensuring it is easy to understand and follow.
Implement a centralized repository where all documented procedures can be stored and accessed by authorized users.
Regularly review and update documentation to reflect changes in processes, technology, or organizational structure.
Provide training sessions to ensure all users are familiar with the documented procedures and know how to access them.

controls.name: change management
controls.description: Changes to the organization, business processes, information processing facilities and systems that affect information security shall be controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal change management process that includes request submission, impact assessment, and approval workflows.
Designate a change advisory board (CAB) to review and approve significant changes affecting information security.
Document all changes, including the rationale, approval, and implementation details, to maintain a clear audit trail.
Conduct regular reviews of the change management process to identify areas for improvement and ensure compliance with security policies.
Train staff on the change management process and the importance of controlling changes to protect information security.

controls.name: capacity management
controls.description: The use of resources shall be monitored, tuned and projections made of future capacity requirements to ensure the required system performance.

deployment_points.name: Implement monitoring tools to track resource usage across systems and applications in real-time.
Analyze historical data to identify trends in resource consumption and predict future capacity needs.
Establish thresholds for resource usage that trigger alerts for potential capacity issues before they impact performance.
Regularly review capacity management reports to inform decision-making regarding resource allocation and upgrades.
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure that capacity planning aligns with business objectives and anticipated growth.

controls.name: separation of development, testing and operational environments
controls.description: Development, testing, and operational environments shall be separated to reduce the risks of unauthorized access or changes to the operational environment.

deployment_points.name: Define clear boundaries between development, testing, and operational environments to prevent cross-contamination.
Implement access controls to restrict personnel from moving between environments without proper authorization.
Use separate servers and databases for development and testing to ensure that operational data remains secure.
Regularly audit the separation of environments to ensure compliance with established policies and identify any vulnerabilities.
Provide training to staff on the importance of maintaining separation and the risks associated with unauthorized access.

controls.name: controls against malware
controls.description: Detection, prevention and recovery controls to protect against malware shall be implemented, combined with appropriate user awareness.

deployment_points.name: Implement antivirus and anti-malware solutions on all endpoints and servers to detect and prevent malware infections.
Schedule regular updates for malware definitions and software to ensure protection against the latest threats.
Conduct user training sessions to raise awareness about malware threats and safe computing practices.
Establish a response plan for malware incidents, including isolation of infected systems and recovery procedures.
Regularly review and test the effectiveness of malware controls and update them based on emerging threats.

controls.name: information backup
controls.description: Backup copies of information, software and system images shall be taken and tested regularly in accordance with an agreed backup policy.

deployment_points.name: Develop a comprehensive backup policy that outlines the frequency, scope, and methods of backups for all critical data.
Implement automated backup solutions to ensure regular and consistent backups of information and system images.
Store backup copies in a secure, offsite location to protect against data loss from physical disasters.
Regularly test backup restoration processes to ensure data can be recovered quickly and accurately when needed.
Review and update the backup policy periodically to adapt to changes in data volume and business requirements.

controls.name: event logging
controls.description: Event logs recording user activities, exceptions, faults and information security events shall be produced, kept and regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Configure systems to generate logs for user activities, security events, and system errors to ensure comprehensive monitoring.
Establish a centralized logging system to collect and store logs from various sources for easier analysis.
Define log retention policies to determine how long logs should be kept based on compliance and operational needs.
Schedule regular reviews of logs to identify anomalies or security incidents that require further investigation.
Implement alerts for critical events to ensure timely responses to potential security threats.

controls.name: protection of log information
controls.description: Logging facilities and log information shall be protected against tampering and unauthorized access.

deployment_points.name: Implement access controls to restrict who can view and modify log files, ensuring only authorized personnel have access.
Use encryption to protect log data both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access and tampering.
Regularly audit access to log files to detect any unauthorized attempts to view or alter log information.
Store logs in a secure location, separate from the systems generating the logs, to reduce the risk of tampering.
Establish a process for securely deleting logs that are no longer needed, in compliance with retention policies.

controls.name: administrator and operator logs
controls.description: System administrator and system operator activities shall be logged and the logs protected and regularly reviewed.

deployment_points.name: Enable detailed logging for all administrative and operational activities on critical systems to ensure accountability.
Implement strict access controls to ensure that only authorized personnel can access administrator and operator logs.
Schedule regular reviews of these logs to identify any unauthorized or suspicious activities that may indicate a security breach.
Use automated tools to analyze logs for patterns that may indicate misuse or misconfiguration of systems.
Retain logs for a defined period to comply with regulatory requirements and facilitate audits.

controls.name: clock synchronisation
controls.description: The clocks of all relevant information processing systems within an organization or security domain shall be synchronised to a single reference time source.

deployment_points.name: Identify a reliable time source, such as an NTP server, to serve as the reference for clock synchronization across all systems.
Configure all relevant information processing systems to synchronize their clocks with the designated time source at regular intervals.
Monitor synchronization status to ensure all systems maintain accurate time and address any discrepancies promptly.
Document the synchronization process and settings to ensure consistency and facilitate troubleshooting.
Regularly review and update the time synchronization configuration to adapt to changes in the network or system architecture.

controls.name: installation of software on operational systems
controls.description: Procedures shall be implemented to control the installation of software on operational systems.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document a formal procedure for software installation that includes approval processes and testing requirements.
Restrict software installation privileges to authorized personnel only, ensuring that users cannot install unauthorized applications.
Implement a software inventory management system to track installed applications and their versions across all operational systems.
Regularly review installed software to ensure compliance with organizational policies and remove any unauthorized applications.
Provide training for personnel involved in software installation to ensure they understand the procedures and security implications.

controls.name: management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems being used shall be obtained in a timely fashion, the organizationΓÇÖs exposure to such vulnerabilities evaluated and appropriate measures taken to address the associated risk.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for regularly monitoring and assessing technical vulnerabilities in all information systems using automated tools.
Maintain an up-to-date inventory of all systems and software to facilitate vulnerability management efforts.
Evaluate the risk associated with identified vulnerabilities and prioritize remediation efforts based on potential impact.
Implement patches and updates promptly to address known vulnerabilities and reduce exposure to threats.
Document and communicate vulnerability management activities to ensure transparency and accountability within the organization.

controls.name: restrictions on software installation
controls.description: Rules governing the installation of software by users shall be established and implemented.

deployment_points.name: Develop clear policies that define which types of software can be installed by users and the approval process required.
Implement technical controls to enforce software installation restrictions, such as application whitelisting or software restriction policies.
Train users on the importance of adhering to software installation policies and the risks associated with unauthorized software.
Regularly review and update the software installation policies to reflect changes in technology and organizational needs.
Monitor compliance with installation policies and take corrective actions when violations occur.

controls.name: information systems audit controls
controls.description: Audit requirements and activities involving verification of operational systems shall be carefully planned and agreed to minimise disruptions to business processes.

deployment_points.name: Develop an audit plan that outlines the scope, objectives, and schedule for auditing operational systems to minimize business disruptions.
Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure that audit activities are communicated and agreed upon in advance.
Use automated auditing tools to streamline the audit process and reduce the impact on system performance.
Document audit findings and recommendations clearly to facilitate follow-up actions and improvements.
Review and update the audit plan regularly to ensure it remains relevant and effective in addressing organizational needs.

controls.name: network controls
controls.description: Networks shall be managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

deployment_points.name: Establish a network management policy that outlines the roles and responsibilities for network security management.
Implement firewalls and intrusion detection systems to monitor and control incoming and outgoing network traffic.
Regularly update network devices and software to protect against vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Conduct periodic network security assessments to identify and mitigate risks associated with network configurations and access controls.
Train staff on network security best practices and incident response procedures to enhance overall network security awareness.

controls.name: security of network services
controls.description: Security mechanisms, service levels and management requirements of all network services shall be identified and included in network services agreements, whether these services are provided in-house or outsourced.

deployment_points.name: Define security requirements for all network services, including encryption, authentication, and access controls.
Include these security requirements in service level agreements (SLAs) with both internal and external service providers.
Regularly review and update SLAs to reflect changes in security standards and organizational needs.
Monitor compliance with SLAs through audits and performance assessments to ensure service providers meet security expectations.
Establish a process for reporting and addressing security incidents related to network services.

controls.name: segregation in networks
controls.description: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated on networks.

deployment_points.name: Identify and categorize information services, users, and systems based on their security requirements and sensitivity levels.
Implement network segmentation using VLANs or subnets to separate different groups and limit access to sensitive information.
Apply access controls to ensure that only authorized users can access specific network segments.
Regularly review and update network segmentation strategies to adapt to changes in organizational structure or security threats.
Conduct training sessions for staff on the importance of network segregation and the procedures for accessing different network segments.

controls.name: information transfer policies and procedures
controls.description: Formal transfer policies, procedures and controls shall be in place to protect the transfer of information through the use of all types of communication facilities.

deployment_points.name: Develop and document formal policies and procedures for the secure transfer of information across all communication channels.
Implement encryption protocols for data in transit to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.
Train employees on the established policies and procedures to ensure compliance and awareness of secure information transfer practices.
Regularly review and update transfer policies to address emerging threats and changes in technology.
Monitor and log information transfers to detect and respond to any unauthorized or suspicious activities.

controls.name: agreements on information transfer
controls.description: Agreements shall address the secure transfer of business information between the organization and external parties.

deployment_points.name: Draft and implement agreements that specify security requirements for the transfer of information to and from external parties.
Include clauses in agreements that outline the responsibilities of both parties regarding data protection and incident response.
Regularly review and update agreements to ensure they reflect current security practices and regulatory requirements.
Conduct risk assessments to identify potential vulnerabilities in information transfer processes with external parties.
Establish a process for monitoring compliance with the agreements and addressing any breaches or violations.

controls.name: electronic messaging
controls.description: Information involved in electronic messaging shall be appropriately protected.

deployment_points.name: Implement encryption for all electronic messaging systems to protect the confidentiality and integrity of messages.
Establish policies for the acceptable use of electronic messaging, including guidelines for sharing sensitive information.
Train employees on secure messaging practices and the importance of protecting sensitive information in communications.
Regularly review and update electronic messaging systems to address vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Monitor electronic messaging for unauthorized access or data breaches and establish incident response procedures.

controls.name: confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
controls.description: Requirements for confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organizationΓÇÖs needs for the protection of information shall be identified, regularly reviewed and documented.

deployment_points.name: Identify the types of information that require confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements based on sensitivity and regulatory requirements.
Draft and implement standard confidentiality and non-disclosure agreements for use with employees, contractors, and third parties.
Regularly review and update agreements to ensure they align with current legal standards and organizational policies.
Maintain a centralized repository for all signed agreements to facilitate tracking and compliance monitoring.
Train relevant staff on the importance of confidentiality agreements and the procedures for handling sensitive information.

controls.name: information security requirements analysis and specification
controls.description: The information security related requirements shall be included in the requirements for new information systems or enhancements to existing information systems.

deployment_points.name: Establish a process for identifying and documenting information security requirements during the system development lifecycle.
Involve stakeholders from IT, security, and business units in the requirements gathering process to ensure comprehensive coverage.
Review and validate security requirements against industry standards and best practices to ensure adequacy.
Integrate security requirements into project plans and timelines to ensure they are addressed throughout the development process.
Conduct regular reviews of existing systems to identify and implement necessary security enhancements.

controls.name: securing application services on public networks
controls.description: Information involved in application services passing over public networks shall be protected from fraudulent activity, contract dispute and unauthorized disclosure and modification.

deployment_points.name: Implement strong encryption protocols for all application services that transmit data over public networks.
Conduct regular security assessments of application services to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security standards.
Establish access controls to limit who can access application services and the data they handle.
Monitor application services for suspicious activities and implement incident response procedures for potential breaches.
Train developers and IT staff on secure coding practices to prevent vulnerabilities in application services.

controls.name: protecting application services transactions
controls.description: Information involved in application service transactions shall be protected to prevent incomplete transmission, mis-routing, unauthorized message alteration, unauthorized disclosure, unauthorized message duplication or replay.

deployment_points.name: Implement transaction validation mechanisms to ensure the integrity and authenticity of application service transactions.
Use encryption to protect transaction data both in transit and at rest to prevent unauthorized access.
Establish logging and monitoring for all transactions to detect and respond to anomalies or unauthorized activities.
Regularly review and test transaction processing systems to identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities.
Train staff on secure transaction processing practices and the importance of protecting transaction data.

controls.name: secure development policy
controls.description: Rules for the development of software and systems shall be established and applied to developments within the organization.

deployment_points.name: Establish a formal secure development policy that outlines security requirements and best practices for software development.
Communicate the secure development policy to all relevant stakeholders, including developers, project managers, and security teams.
Conduct training sessions to ensure that all personnel involved in development understand and can apply the secure development policy.
Regularly review and update the secure development policy to reflect changes in technology, threats, and organizational needs.
Implement a compliance monitoring process to ensure adherence to the secure development policy throughout the development lifecycle.

controls.name: system change control procedures
controls.description: Changes to systems within the development lifecycle shall be controlled by the use of formal change control procedures.

deployment_points.name: Develop formal change control procedures that define the process for requesting, reviewing, and approving changes to systems.
Ensure that all change requests are documented and include a risk assessment to evaluate potential impacts on security and functionality.
Establish a change control board (CCB) to review and approve significant changes before implementation.
Maintain a change log to track all changes made, including the rationale for each change and any associated testing results.
Conduct post-implementation reviews to assess the effectiveness of changes and identify any issues that may arise.

controls.name: technical review of applications after operating platform changes
controls.description: When operating platforms are changed, business critical applications shall be reviewed and tested to ensure there is no adverse impact on organizational operations or security.

deployment_points.name: Establish a protocol for conducting technical reviews of applications following any changes to the operating platform.
Identify business-critical applications that require review and prioritize them based on their importance to organizational operations.
Develop a testing plan that includes functional, performance, and security testing to assess the impact of the platform change on applications.
Document the results of the technical review and testing, including any identified issues and remediation steps taken.
Communicate findings to relevant stakeholders and ensure that any necessary adjustments are made to applications before they are put back into production.

controls.name: restrictions on changes to software packages
controls.description: Modifications to software packages shall be discouraged, limited to necessary changes and all changes shall be strictly controlled.

deployment_points.name: Establish guidelines that discourage unnecessary modifications to software packages and outline acceptable reasons for making changes.
Implement a formal approval process for any modifications to software packages, requiring justification and risk assessment.
Maintain a version control system to track all changes made to software packages, including who made the change and when.
Conduct regular audits of software packages to ensure compliance with the established restrictions and identify unauthorized changes.
Provide training to development teams on the importance of adhering to restrictions on software package modifications and the potential risks of non-compliance.

controls.name: secure system engineering principles
controls.description: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system implementation efforts.

deployment_points.name: Define and document secure system engineering principles that align with industry best practices and organizational security requirements.
Integrate secure engineering principles into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) to ensure they are applied consistently across all projects.
Provide training and resources to development teams to ensure they understand and can effectively implement secure engineering principles.
